Game.name: Assassin's Creed: Origins - God's Edition
Game.description_short:
Unveil forgotten myths of the mighty Egyptian Gods with the Assassin’s Creed Origins – Gods Collector’s Edition. Featuring Bayek, a protector of Egypt whose personal story will lead to the creation of the Assassin’s Brotherhood, standing on the statue of Sekhmet, the lioness goddess.

Gods Editions content:
High-end: Bayek’s on Sekhmet Goddess statue (height 26cm) - By Ubicollectibles.
Premium Egyptian Gods themed package.
The Assassin’s Creed Origins Standard Edition, the Digital Deluxe Pack and an additional mission.
The game’s art book: Featuring the artworks from Ubisoft Montreal artists that lead to the creation of the game.
The world map: Explore the Egypt of Assassin’s Creed Origins with this hand-drawn artistic representation.
The game’s official soundtrack.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed: The Americas Collection
Game.description: Assassin's Creed: The Americas Collection is a compilation consisting of three games in the Assassin's Creed series. The Americas Collection includes Assassin's Creed III, Assassin's Creed: Liberation HD and Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag.
Game.description_short: This Bundle Contains three games i.e, Assassin's Creed III, Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag, Assassin's Creed Liberation HD.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed: Odyssey - Deluxe Edition
Game.description_short:
Assassin's Creed: Odyssey - Deluxe Edition includes:

The Kronos Pack (Including 5 epic pieces of armour, 1 epic weapon, 1 epic mount).
The Herald of Dusk Pack (Including 5 rare pieces of armour, 1 rare weapon).
The Capricornus Naval Pack (Including 1 ship design, 1 crew theme).
1 Temporary XP Boost.
1 Temporary Drachm.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed: Origins - Deluxe Edition
Game.description_short:
The Deluxe Pack includes:
- The Ambush at Sea mission
- The Desert Cobra Pack (including 1 outfit, 2 legendary weapons, 1 legendary shield, and 1 mount)
- 3 Ability Points

Game.name: Assassin's Creed: Syndicate - Gold Edition
Game.description_short:
London, 1868. The Industrial Revolution unleashes an age of invention, transforming the lives of millions with technologies once thought impossible. But industrialization only fattens the purses of a privileged few, while workers struggle to survive in the factories that make London the beating heart of the global economy— until an Assassin rallies to their defense, sparking an epic conflict that will echo throughout history. Create the world’s first organized crime family. Conquer the streets of London. Bring the ruling class to their knees. And rise to lead the London underworld in a visceral adventure unlike anything you've played before.

Gold Edition includes game and Season Pass- featuring a major expansion plus digital content and exclusives.

Season Pass included:
10 hours of extra gameplay: Jack the Ripper campaign, the Last Maharaja mission pack, "A Long Night" exclusive mission, the Streets of London gameplay pack, new gears, weapons, a permanent xp boost and 500 Helix Credits.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Syndicate: Jack the Ripper
Game.description_short:
Let the hunt begin... 20 years after the events of Assassin’s Creed Syndicate, ‘JACK THE RIPPER’ has embarked on a brutal reign of terror that shocks London to its core and threatens the very existence of the Brotherhood of Assassins.

Experience this chilling campaign and access additional exclusive content as part of the Assassin's Creed Syndicate Season Pass.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Brotherhood: Deluxe Edition
Game.description_short:
This Deluxe Edition contains:

- Assassin's Creed Brotherhood (base game)
- Additional single-player mission: Aquaducts and Trajan Market
- The Harlequin and Officer multiplayer characters
- Helmschmied Drachen Armor for Ezio
- Digital multiplayer characters trading cards
- Map of Rome
- A download for the movie Assassin’s Creed: Lineage
- Digital soundtrack
- Making-of for Assassin’s Creed: Brotherhood

Game.name: Assassin's Creed II: Bonfire of the Vanities
Game.description:
The Bonfire of the Vanities was the second of two downloadable content packs developed by Ubisoft for Assassin's Creed II.

The DLC included access to the Oltrarno District of Florence, as well as three Templar Lairs, which were previously exclusive to special editions of the game.
Game.description_short:
The Bonfire of the Vanities took place nine years after the events of the Battle of Forlì. Florence had fallen under the rule of the monk Girolamo Savonarola, who controlled the city with nine lieutenants, and with the Apple of Eden he had stolen from a critically wounded Ezio Auditore.

After traveling to Florence to retrieve the Apple, Ezio met with Niccolò Machiavelli in the city's Oltrarno District. There, Niccolò tasked him with assassinating Savonarola's lieutenants, who terrorized the people and kept them docile.

After the nine lieutenants had fallen, the people of Florence rose up, and charged Savonarola's residence at the Palazzo Pitti. There, they drove him out, and though Savonarola attempted to subdue them with the Apple, Ezio knocked the Piece of Eden out of his hand with a throwing knife. The civilians then brought the monk to be burned at the stake in the Piazza della Signoria.

As the Assassins followed the mob to the plaza, Ezio concluded that no one deserved to die in such pain, and killed Savonarola with his Hidden Blade before he could suffer. He then gave the people of Florence a speech about how they should follow their own path, and not that of anyone else.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed: Odyssey - Ultimate Edition
Game.description_short: Write your epic odyssey and become a legendary Spartan hero in a world shaped by your choices. Get powerful gear, two new stories across six episodes in the season pass, and Assassin's Creed III Remastered for 4K and HDR upon its release.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed: Revelations - Gold Edition
Game.description_short:
The Gold Edition contains the main game and also the three available DLC's. So the games within this compilation are:

- Assassin's Creed: Revelations
- Assassin's Creed: Revelations - The Ancestors Character Pack
- Assassin's Creed: Revelations - Mediterranean Traveler Map Pack
- Assassin's Creed: Revelations - The Lost Archive

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Syndicate: The Last Maharaja
Game.description_short: The Last Maharaja is a single-player downloadable content addition for Assassin's Creed: Syndicate and was released on 1 March 2016. The content consists of ten missions in which Jacob and Evie Frye aid Duleep Singh, the youngest son of Ranjit Singh, in reclaiming his birthright as Maharaja.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed: Unity - Collector's Edition
Game.description_short:
The Collector’s Edition of Assassin’s Creed: Unity comes in a Notre Dame Cathedral collector’s showcase box and includes the following content:

- 16″ Arno Figurine
- Art Book
- Music Box
- Soundtrack
- Single Player missions DLC
- The Science Mission
- The Chemical Revolution

Game.name: Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag - Gold Edition
Game.description_short:
The immersive world of Assassins Creed Black Flag drops you into the heart of an explosive reimagining of maritime history. Play as young privateer Edward Kenway, fighting side by side with the most notorious Caribbean pirates of the 18th century. As captain of the Jackdaw, Master Assassin and ruthless pirate, seek adventure on both sea and land in the biggest world that Assassins Creed has yet conceived. Through raging waters, lush jungles and sunbaked cities, seek and destroy scheming Templars and oppressive colonial powers, while enriching yourself and your outlaw compatriots with ships and gold.

Download Black Flag Gold Edition, and enrich the gameplay experience with exclusive island treasure hunts. Unlock multiplayer options, weapons, ships and valuable relics in these bonus packs, making yourself a richer, stronger and more formidable foe. Follow paths set by great pirates who came before, and discover the wealth they left behind. Captain Morgan's ship and silver pistols are yours for the taking in the Black Island pack, while the shallows of Sacrifice Island yield treasures left by Captain Drake in the Sacrificed Secrets Pack. Find the ship and other items left behind by Blackbeard's friend Stede Bonnet on St. Lucia in the Hidden Mystery Pack. Other exclusive packs include Captain Kenway's Legacy Pack, the Pirate's Bounty Pack and the Trove of Mystery Pack.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed IV Black Flag: Guild of Rogues
Game.description_short: The chaos ensues as three new fearless adventurers ready themselves for the challenge. Test your skill and wisdom against: The Stowaway, the mischievous, talkative spy The Shaman, the crafty houngan asogwe (high priest) The Mermaid, a Templar navigational expert who gave her heart to the sea. This pack also comes with new customization options, and new moves.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag - Skull Edition
Game.description_short:
This edition contains:

- Jumbo steel case
- Artbook
- Two lithographs
- Official soundtrack
- Single player missions: Hidden Mystery and Sacrificed Secrets
- In-game content: Captain Kenway's Legacy

Game.name: Assassin's Creed: Rogue - Digital Deluxe Edition
Game.description_short:
In addition to the full game, the Deluxe Edition comes packed with bonus in-game content including:

- The Armor of Sir Gunn Quest
- The Siege of Fort de Sable
- The Master Templar Pack
- The Explorer Pack
- Four Time Savers Packs

Game.name: Assassin's Creed IV Black Flag: Death Vessel Pack
Game.description_short: Give a fearsome look to your ship with those 3 unique customization items: The Death Vessel Figurehead, Death Vessel Sails and Death Vessel Wheel.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag - Limited Edition
Game.description_short:
Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag - Limited Edition contains the essential items for gamers to Unite under the Black Flag.

Along with a copy of the game, customers will receive:
A stunning 18" assassin statue
An embroidered 28"X 48" flag
An exclusive 80-page art book
Steelbook gamae case and an epic soundtrack

Game.name: Assassin's Creed IV Black Flag: Blackbeard's Wrath
Game.description_short: Ready for another sea-worthy challenge? This pack contains three new fearsome contenders who will keep you on your toes: The Jaguar, a good and mighty Aztec Templar Blackbeard, the most feared pirate of the seven seas The Orchid, the stone-hearted pirate queen. Test your abilities by engaging in countless battles against these cold-blooded champions.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag - Buccaneer Edition
Game.description_short:
Welcome to the Golden Age of Piracy. The year is 1715. Pirates rule the Caribbean and have established their own lawless Republic where corruption, greediness and cruelty are commonplace. Among these outlaws is a brash young captain named Edward Kenway. His fight for glory has earned him the respect of legends like Blackbeard, but also drawn him into the ancient war between Assassins and Templars, a war that may destroy everything the pirates have built.

A Brash Rebel Assassin: Become Edward Kenway, a charismatic yet brutal pirate captain, trained by Assassins. Edward can effortlessly switch between the Hidden Blade of the Assassin’s Order and all new weaponry including four flintlock pistols and dual cutlass swords.

The Assassin’s Creed IV Black Flag Buccaneer Edition includes:

A 45cm figurine of Captain Edward Kenway.

Collector’s box.

A high quality artbook including artworks that inspired the game.

The Official Game Soundtrack.

2 lithographs in a protective envelope.

Unlockable bonus content: 3 additional solo missions for an extra 45 minutes of gameplay:

Black Island: Captain Morgan’s favourite ship has sunken off the coast with a full load of legendary sailing equipment. Explore the Black Island and retrieve these items Pirates have desperately been looking for.

Hidden Mystery: Follow Stede Bonnet’s path and find the secrets of his adventures on the beautiful island of St Lucia.

Sacrificed Secrets: Recover Captain Drake’s lost treasures, including golden flintlocks and cutlass when exploring the exotic island of Sacrifices.

Additional Single & Multiplayer items: Captain Kenway’s Legacy.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed: Origins - Dawn of the Creed Edition
Game.description_short: The ultimate edition wasn't enough? Then take a look at the Dawn Collector Edition for Assassin's Creed Origins. This one has a ton of cool collectibles.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed IV Black Flag: Illustrious Pirates Pack
Game.description_short: Explore new locations and discover the secrets of the Black island, Mystery Island and Sacrifice Island to find hidden treasure chest to get access to new outfits and weapons for Edward, and figureheads and sails for you ship, the Jackdaw. Stand out in multiplayer with new and exclusive costume sets, pictures, titles, relics and emblems!

Game.name: Assassin's Creed IV Black Flag: Crusader & Florentine Pack
Game.description_short: Sail with Altaïr and Ezio’s colors with 4 customisation items for your ship and 2 new weapons for Edward: Ezio’s Iconic Figurehead, Ezio’s Unique Sails, Ezio’s Swords, Altaïr’s Iconic Figurehead, Altaïr’s Unique Sails, Altaïr’s Sword.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed IV Black Flag: Time Saver - Resources Pack
Game.description_short: Increase your Ship’s cargo storage limit to 2500 and obtain 500 additional Metal, wood, cloth, sugar and rum resources.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed IV Black Flag: Time Saver - Activities Pack
Game.description_short: This pack will save you time by revealing all of the activity locations on your map.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed IV Black Flag: Time Saver - Technology Pack
Game.description_short: Obtain a technology advantage that removes the requirement to find the 18 Upgrade Plans to be able to buy the higher ship upgrades (gameplay and cosmetic upgrades).

Game.name: Assassin's Creed IV Black Flag: Time Saver - Collectibles Pack
Game.description_short: This pack will save you time by revealing all of the collectibles locations on your map. Note that you will still need to travel to these locations and beat the game play in order to get the rewards.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed: Origins - Dawn of the Creed Legendary Edition
Game.description_short: Be among the firsts to dive into the Assassin’s Creed Origins universe with this never seen before Collector’s Edition. Featuring a 73cm high-end resin statue of Bayek, a protector of Egypt whose personal story will lead to the creation of the Assassin’s Brotherhood, and his eagle Senu, this exceptional Collector’s Edition is ready to be shipped exclusively on the Ubisoft Store with only 999 units Worldwide.

Game.name: Assassin's Vol.
Game.description_short: Assassin's Vol. is a level puzzle game.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Mythology Pack
Game.description_short: A bundle including three Assassin's Creed titles: Assassin's Creed Valhalla, Assassin's Creed Odyssey, and Assassin's Creed Origins.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Ezio Auditore Pack
Game.description_short:
This bundle contains:

- Assassin's Creed II
- Assassin's Creed Brotherhood
- Assassin's Creed Revelations

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Origins: Deluxe Pack
Game.description_short:
Ancient Egypt, a land of majesty and intrigue, is disappearing in a ruthless fight for power. Unveil dark secrets and forgotten myths as you go back to the one founding moment: The Origins of the Assassin’s Brotherhood.

The Deluxe Pack includes:
- The Ambush at Sea mission.
- The Desert Cobra pack (Including 1 outfit, 2 legendary weapons, 1 legendary shield and 1 mount)
- 3 Ability points

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: River Raids
Game.description:
River Raids is a free update for Assassin's Creed: Valhalla. Released as part of Title Update 1.1.2, the update adds the replayable river raiding mode based on the existing raiding feature in the base game and introduces three distinct maps of rivers for players to explore; namely the River Exe, the River Severn and the River Dee. The update also added new quests and a set of armor and weapon to obtain through the new map.

An additional update in conjunction with the Ostara Season content added a second armor set to be obtained.

A third update introducing the River Erriff, the River Berbha and the River Rhine was released on 7 September 2021, featuring new questlines to obtain Lugh's Spear and the Ulfberht Sword.
Game.description_short: It all starts with the construction of the River Incursions Dock, where we recruit specific Jomsvikings for these navigations. Vagn, a dark-skinned Viking, is our guide in this expansion. We chose one of the six rivers on the map to navigate and we went on the attack! The new maps are all based on river systems, which consist of a meandering main course with islands and interconnecting side channels. Scattered along the banks of the river are civilian settlements, military compounds, monasteries and druid camps. Each of these location types offers different challenges and rewards. The maps are: River Exe, River Severn, River Dee, River Erriff, River Berbha and my favorite: the River Rhine (it's in France and it has a very big city, I was impressed!).

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Mirage: Deluxe Edition
Game.description_short:
In Assassin's Creed Mirage, you are Basim, a cunning street thief with nightmarish visions seeking answers and justice. Join an ancient organization and come to understand a new creed – one that will change Basim’s fate in ways he never could have imagined.

The Deluxe Edition includes a Prince of Persia–inspired outfit, eagle and mount skins, weapons, and more!

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Gold Edition
Game.description:
In Assassin's Creed: Valhalla, become Eivor, a legendary Viking raider on a quest for glory. Explore a dynamic and beautiful open world set against the brutal backdrop of England’s Dark Ages. Raid your enemies, grow your settlement, and build your political power in the quest to earn a place among the gods in Valhalla.

Assassin's Creed: Valhalla - Gold Edition includes the game and the Season Pass.
Game.description_short: Playable as female or male, Eivor leads a clan of Norse people across the icy North Sea to flee Norway’s endless war and dwindling resources. If they hope to survive, they’ll have to build a new home in the hostile lands of England. There, you’ll provide for yourself and your people by constructing, customizing, and upgrading your settlement with new buildings like barracks, blacksmiths, and tattoo parlors, all while recruiting new members to grow your clan.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed: Liberation Remastered
Game.description:
Assassin's Creed: Liberation Remastered is a remastered version of Assassin's Creed III: Liberation.
The original game, developed by Ubisoft Sofia, made its debut on PlayStation Vita in 2012. Two years later, it received its HD version, released on PC, PlayStation 3, and Xbox 360.
This version incluide new character models, polished environment rendering, and more.
Gameplay mechanics have been revamped as well, improving your experience and your immersion.
Game.description_short: Assassin's Creed III: Liberation Remastered takes place between 1765-1780. The main character of this game is called Aveline de Gandpré. She is fighting for freedom and justice under the guidance of Agate - a former slave and a master of the Assassin Brotherhood in New Orleans. Although the title lacks references to Desmond Miles' adventures, Connor, the main character of Assassin's Creed III, appears in it. Moreover, it is worth mentioning that the whole game is stylized on a propaganda product developed by the evil Abstergo corporation.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Deluxe Edition
Game.description_short:
Includes the game and Ultimate Pack, which contains the Berserker Gear Pack, Berserker Settlement Pack, and more!

Become Eivor, a legendary Viking warrior raised on tales of battle and glory. Explore a dynamic open world set against the brutal backdrop of England's Dark Ages. Raid your enemies, grow your clan's settlement, and build your political power on a quest for glory.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed: Unity - Limited Edition
Game.description_short:
The Limited Edition release of Assassin's Creed: Unity includes the base game and a code to download the Chemical Revolution mission, which isn't available as standalone DLC.

Paris, 1789. The French Revolution turns a once-magnificent city into a place of terror and chaos. Its cobblestone streets run red with the blood of commoners who dared to rise up against the oppressive aristocracy. As the nation tears itself apart, a young man named Arno will embark on an extraordinary journey to expose the true powers behind the Revolution. His pursuit will throw him into the middle of a ruthless struggle for the fate of a nation, and transform him into a true Master Assassin.

Introducing Assassin’s Creed Unity, the next-gen evolution of the blockbuster franchise powered by an all-new game engine. From the storming of the Bastille to the execution of King Louis XVI, experience the French Revolution as never before, and help the people of France carve an entirely new destiny.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed: Odyssey - Medusa Edition
Game.description_short:
The Medusa Edition of the 2018 game Assassin's Creed: Odyssey is a European-only exclusive game, comes in a limited edition cardboard box, and contains:

.- The game Assassin's Creed: Odyssey
.- The the Kronos Gear Pack and XP and Drachma Boost as extra downloadable content (DLC).
.- The extra mission The Blind King
.- Early access, three days prior to the actual launch date.
.- A world map
.- Official soundtrack CD
.- An art book
.- An Ubicollectibles figurine of the Gorgon Medusa.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed: Unity - Bastille Edition
Game.description_short:
Paris, 1789. The French Revolution turns a once-magnificent city into a place of terror and chaos. Its cobblestoned streets run red with the blood of commoners who dare to rise up against an oppressive aristocracy. Yet as the nation tears itself apart, a young man named Arno will embark upon an extraordinary journey to expose the true powers behind the Revolution. His pursuit will throw him into the middle of a ruthless struggle for the fate of a nation, and transform him into a true Master Assassin.

The Bastille Edition contains a steelbook case, an artbook, an envelope with two lithographs, soundtrack cd and bonus missions "The Chemical Revolution" and "The American Prisoner"

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Complete Edition
Game.description_short:
Includes the game, all expansions, and more!

In Assassin's Creed Valhalla, you are Eivor, a fierce Viking warrior raised on tales of battle and glory. Explore a mysterious and beautiful open world set against the brutal backdrop of England's Dark Ages. Raid your enemies, grow your settlement, and build your political power in the quest to earn a place among the gods in Valhalla.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Dawn of Ragnarök
Game.description: In the most ambitious expansion in franchise history, Eivor must embrace their destiny as Odin, the Norse god of Battle and Wisdom. Unleash new divine powers as you embark on a desperate quest through a breathtaking world. Complete a legendary Viking saga and save your son in the face of the gods’ doom.
Game.description_short:
Wield incredible, otherworldly powers. Absorb new abilities from those you’ve defeated and use them to slay all who stand in your way. Shape-shift into a raven for spectacular assassinations or resurrect your defeated foes to fight on your side. Transform your skin into magma to protect yourself, infuse your weapon with ice to unleash devastating strikes, and more.

Faced with visions of a new threat, Eivor must embrace their destiny as Odin and enter the mythical dwarven realm of Svartalfheim, a beautiful but hostile world under invasion. From underground forges to soaring golden peaks, immerse yourself in a vast, perilous new world of Norse mythology as you embrace your fate as a Norse god.

Face off against Jotnars, foes of ice from Jotunheim, and Muspels, new enemies of fire from Muspelheim. Battle a wide range of enemy archetypes, infiltrate their strongholds, and wield their own powers against them as you grow stronger. At the head of this army stands Surtr, an unkillable fire giant and the greatest enemy that Odin has ever faced.

As Odin, embark on a desperate quest to rescue your son, Baldr, from imprisonment at the hands of an unspeakable foe. Use your wit and cunning to infiltrate hostile territory, gain dwarven allies, and take revenge on Baldr’s captors. Odin’s journey will force him to confront his own fate against the certain doom of Ragnarök.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Ragnarök Edition
Game.description_short:
Includes the game and the epic Dawn of Ragnarök expansion!

In Assassin's Creed Valhalla, you are Eivor, a fierce Viking warrior raised on tales of battle and glory. Explore a mysterious and beautiful open world set against the brutal backdrop of England's Dark Ages. Raid your enemies, grow your settlement, and build your political power in the quest to earn a place among the gods in Valhalla.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: The Last Chapter
Game.description_short:
The Last Chapter is a free update for Assassin's Creed: Valhalla and is the final part of Eivor Varinsdottir's story.

While it was originally planned to release with Update 1.6.2 on 6 December 2022, an unforeseen scheduling error made it release a week early on 29 November instead.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Ultimate Edition
Game.description:
In Assassin's Creed: Valhalla, become Eivor, a legendary Viking raider on a quest for glory. Explore a dynamic and beautiful open world set against the brutal backdrop of England’s Dark Ages. Raid your enemies, grow your settlement, and build your political power in the quest to earn a place among the gods in Valhalla.

Assassin's Creed: Valhalla - Ultimate Edition includes the game, the Ultimate Pack and the Season Pass.
Game.description_short: Playable as female or male, Eivor leads a clan of Norse people across the icy North Sea to flee Norway’s endless war and dwindling resources. If they hope to survive, they’ll have to build a new home in the hostile lands of England. There, you’ll provide for yourself and your people by constructing, customizing, and upgrading your settlement with new buildings like barracks, blacksmiths, and tattoo parlors, all while recruiting new members to grow your clan.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed: Odyssey - Spartan Edition
Game.description_short:
The Spartan Edition of the 2018 game Assassin's Creed: Odyssey is a ubistore exclusive game, comes in a limited edition cardboard box, and contains:

A retail copy of Assassin's Creed: Odyssey
A 39.5cm Spartan Leap statue, with interchangeable Alexios and Kassandra figurines.
A Steelbook
A copy of the official artbook
A copy of the world map
A copy of the official soundtrack (selected tracks)
A copy of Hugo Puzzuoli's Athens lithograph
The Season Pass
The Deluxe Pack
A Medal Necklace (PS4 and Xbox One only, for the first 10,000 pre-orders)

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: A Fated Encounter
Game.description: A Fated Encounter was a virtual representation of one of Eivor Varinsdottir's genetic memories, relived by Layla Hassan in 2020 through the Portable Animus HR-8.5. It was added via Title Update 1.4.1.
Game.description_short: The crossover sees both games receive a new free story arc update, with "Those Who Are Treasured" in Odyssey that sees Kassandra travel to the island of Korfu to explore the aftermath of obtaining the immortality-granting Staff of Hermes Trismegistus, while "A Fated Encounter" in Valhalla has Eivor travel to the Isle of Skye, where she encounters Kassandra.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Mastery Challenge
Game.description_short: Mastery Challenge is a free update that adds replayable trials designed to assess player proficiency in melee, ranged, and stealth objectives. As players complete these challenges, they can unlock a variety of unique rewards, including weapons, tattoos, and decorations.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed: Liberation HD - Bonus Pack
Game.description_short:
Assassin’s Creed Liberation HD is the remastering of the stunning pre-American Revolution chapter of the Assassin’s Creed saga. Discover the Bonus pack, and employ brand new weapon improvements for Aveline to enhance her fighting skills.

This pack contains two new weapons: the Pirate Scimitar and the Voodoo Dagger; and two new weapon upgrades: the Gun Powder Pouch and Poison Dart Pouch upgrades.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed III: The Hidden Secrets Pack
Game.description_short: The Hidden Secrets Pack for Assassin's Creed III adds three extra missions for an additional hour of gameplay, taking you from the Lost Mayan Ruins to the high seas. Every success is rewarded with an in-game weapon!

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: The Siege of Paris
Game.description_short: Sail to the kingdom of Francia and engage the forces of Charles the Fat as you participate in the Vikings' most daring conquest. Infiltrate the city of Paris, forge new alliances within its walls, and strike a blow that will shatter an empire.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Title Update 1.5.1
Game.description_short: This update comes with bug fixes and patches, as well as the Mastery Challenge Pack 2, the annual Ostara Festival, and more.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed: Syndicate - Special Edition
Game.description_short:
Assassins Creed Syndicate is set in London, 1868. The Industrial Revolution unleashes an incredible age of invention, transforming the lives of millions with technologies once thought impossible. Opportunities created during this period have people rushing to London to engage in this new world, a world no longer controlled by kings, emperors, politicians, or religion, but by a new common denominator: money.

Not everyone is able to enjoy the benefits of this boom, however. Despite fueling the engine of the British Empire, workers lives are little more than legalized slavery while the top few percent profit from their labor. Living poor and dying young, the lower class unite in protest as a new kind of family, gangs, who turn to a life in the underworld in their struggle to survive. A struggle, until watchful Assassins come to their side and re-ignite an age-old conflict involving Londons leaders that will echo throughout modern history, from the underground up.

Introducing Jacob Frye, who with the help of his twin sister Evie, will change the fate of millions in Assassins Creed Syndicate. Rise to rally and lead the underworld to break the corrupt stranglehold on London in a visceral adventure filled with action, intrigue, and brutal combat.

Exclusive Content: Includes 10 Exclusive Missions "The Dreadful Crimes"

Game.name: Assassin's Creed III: The Battle Hardened Pack
Game.description_short: The Battle Hardened Pack extends the Assassin’s Creed III multiplayer experience with three new playable characters and maps, plus awesome bonus items! Become the influential Governor, the resilient Highlander, or the fearsome Coyote Man.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Odyssey: The Fate of Atlantis
Game.description_short: The story arc will be cut into three episodes, with each episode being released roughly every six weeks after the release of the first, and will set players against mythic creatures while they uncover the mysteries of the fabled sunken city of Atlantis.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Collector's Edition
Game.description_short: In Assassin's Creed Valhalla, become Eivor, a legendary Viking raider on a quest for glory. Explore a dynamic and beautiful open world set against the brutal backdrop of England’s Dark Ages. Raid your enemies, grow your settlement, and build your political power in the quest to earn a place among the gods in Valhalla.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Tombs of the Fallen
Game.description_short: Tombs of the Fallen is a free content update introduced in version 1.4.0 of Assassin’s Creed Valhalla. It adds a series of puzzle-oriented tombs that invite players to explore vast underground caverns filled with traps, poison, and environmental challenges. Players must use observation, exploration, and parkour skills to navigate these ancient structures and uncover hidden treasures linked to the lore of a long-lost civilization. The content emphasizes non-combat exploration and environmental problem-solving over traditional missions. Additional tombs expanding this feature were released with title update 1.6.1

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Wrath of the Druids
Game.description_short: Eivor’s latest journey takes them to shores of Ireland, where the newly-appointed High-King Flann Sinna seeks to unite four disparate regions under a single Irish banner. Along the way, Eivor will discover the secrets of an ancient druidic cult, encounter fearsome mythological creatures, and explore Ireland’s many mysteries.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Syndicate: The Dreadful Crimes
Game.description: 1868: a series of unexplainable events strike London. Inspired by the famous penny-dreadful stories, this pack includes over nine individual missions that culminate in the final mission, which takes place in one of London’s most iconic locations. Work with one of history’s most iconic figures as your ally, a young Sir Arthur Conan Doyle. Bringing a new style of gameplay to the Assassin’s Creed experience, use your wit to solve and connect the clues that will help you solve these dreadful crimes. Find the culprit and unlock exclusive gear and weapons for both Jacob and Evie. Complete five missions and unlock a cloak for Evie and a belt for Jacob, or solve all nine missions and unlock a combat cane!
Game.description_short:
The Frye twins are approached by Henry Raymond, a penny dreadful writer, as well as his follower, a young Arthur Conan Doyle. They team up to investigate a series of murders across London, visiting crime scenes, gathering evidence, interviewing witnesses and suspects, and ultimately solving the crimes by accusing the true perpetrators.

The twins are eventually summoned to Buckingham Palace by Queen Victoria, in order to solve the murder of one of her guards. It turns out that it is in fact Raymond who has posed as a guard and faked his own death, so he may steal the Queen's Sceptre of the Dove by observing up close the combination to the safe that holds it. He has also left a series of false clues suggesting a bomb threat in the palace in order to cover his escape. However Doyle has already uncovered his plan and set out to stop him, but is held hostage on the palace roof in the process. One of the Fryes manages to distract Raymond while the other sneaks up and kills him, saving Doyle and recovering the Sceptre. In the aftermath, the Fryes encourage Doyle to try his own hand at writing detective fiction.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Unity: The Chemical Revolution
Game.description_short: In this extra mission, help Lavoisier, considered to be the "Father of Modern Chemistry", to escape from his kidnappers and recover his poison bomb formula.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag - Deluxe Edition
Game.description_short: This pack contains new locations to discover and explore: Sacrifice Island, Black Island and Mystery Island and exclusives costumes, pictures, titles, relics and emblems for multiplayer.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Odyssey: The Fate of Atlantis - Episode 3: Judgment of Atlantis
Game.description_short: The final episode of The Fate of Atlantis DLC sends players to Poseidon's domain, the legendary lost world, a complete mystery to every culture. We discover that it is a mythical world where Isu and humans live and work together in the utopia created by The Ones Who Came Before. A gorgeous landscape of architectural progress and clear water, Atlantis is a playground for Isu knowledge and power.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Revelations: Mediterranean Traveler Map Pack
Game.description_short:
The Mediterranean Traveler Map Pack extends the Assassin’s Creed Revelations multiplayer experience with the addition of six multiplayer maps, each introducing new gameplay opportunities through their varied terrain, perches, and hideouts.

Journey to the majestic holy city of Jerusalem, the opulent Imperial district of Constantinople, and the colorful mercantile district of Dyers. Revisit your favorite Italian Renaissance maps from Assassin’s Creed Brotherhood, starting with the historic city of Firenze (Florence), traveling to the mountainsides of San Donato, and to nighttime Siena with its carnival lights, talented performers, and deadly hiding spots.

This all-new downloadable content also comes with a new collection of Achievements and Trophies for those that want to try their hand at kills and escapes that are as impressive as they are effective.

Give all your multiplayer characters some personal style with bonus multiplayer customization items, also included in the pack.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed III: Tyranny of King Washington - The Infamy
Game.description_short: In the first episode of The Tyranny of King Washington, the American Revolution is over but the true battle is just beginning. In The Infamy, George Washington, blinded by a thirst for unlimited power, has declared himself king.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Revelations: The Ancestors Character Pack
Game.description_short: The Ancestors Character Pack features four new multiplayer characters, including: the swashbuckling Privateer, the devious siren Corsair, the battle-tested Brigand, and the bloodthirsty Gladiator. Each character is unique, with personalized taunts, weapons, and stylized assassination techniques.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla + Immortals Fenyx Rising Bundle
Game.description_short: This bundle includes two Ubisoft games: Assassin's Creed Valhalla and Immortals Fenyx Rising.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Tombs of the Fallen Pack 2
Game.description_short:
This free title update (1.6.1) expands on the Tombs of the Fallen that were introduced in update 1.4.0.

The journey of Tombs of the Fallen comes to an epic conclusion in this all-new addition. Find your way through three mysterious tombs rigged with ancient traps and complex puzzles. Only the most dedicated adventurers will discover buried secrets from a fallen civilization.

Observe and explore deep waters, molten lava, and Isu teachings to solve ancient puzzles and acquire lost treasures.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Rogue: Time Saver - Activities Pack
Game.description_short: This pack will save you time by revealing all of the activity locations on your map.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: The Way of the Berserker
Game.description_short: The Way of the Berserker is a single-player downloadable content addition for Assassin's Creed: Valhalla and was released on 10 November 2020 as a pre-order bonus. The content consists of three missions in which Eivor joins a legendary Norse Berserker on his quest for revenge.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Odyssey: Legacy of the First Blade
Game.description_short: The expansion introduces players to the first person to ever use the Hidden Blade and will reveal more about the history that ultimately led to the formation of the Assassins.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Syndicate: Streets of London Pack
Game.description:
With over 45 minutes of gameplay, this pack contains missions, weapons and gear to expand your Assassin's Creed: Syndicate experience.

Finally, this pack comes with a variety of equipment & weapons for both Jacob & Evie: 13 weapons, 6 pieces of gear and 3 outfits.
Game.description_short: Starting with The Darwin and Dickens Conspiracy Missions: Embark on two pulse-pounding missions that will take you into the inner sanctums of London’s most influential men. Defend Charles Darwin’s discoveries from those who would kill to silence him. And help the friend of legendary writer Charles Dickens, keep a secret that could get him killed. This pack also includes the Runaway Train Mission: as a runaway train thunders through London at top speed, you must find and fix the train’s critical flaws before you run out of time.

Game.name: Assassin’s Creed Mirage: Master Assassin Edition
Game.description_short: Are you ready to give up who you once thought you were and walk the path of shadows? Elevate your Assassin's Creed Mirage experience with the Master Assassin Edition, which includes the base game, the Deluxe Pack, and five other packs.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed Unity: Secrets of the Revolution
Game.description_short: The Revolution is not over, the people of Paris still need your help.

Game.name: Assassin's Creed: Syndicate - Rooks Edition
Game.description_short:
London, 1868. The Industrial Revolution unleashes an incredible age of invention, transforming the lives of millions with technologies once thought impossible. Opportunities created during this period have people rushing to London to engage in this new world, a world no longer controlled by kings, emperors, politicians, or religion, but by a new common denominator: money.

Not everyone is able to enjoy the benefits of this boom, however. Despite fueling the engine of the British Empire, workers’ lives are little more than legalized slavery while the top few percent profit from their labor. Living poor and dying young, the lower class unite in protest as a new kind of family, gangs, who turn to a life in the underworld in their struggle to survive. A struggle, until watchful Assassins come to their side and re-ignite an age-old conflict involving London’s leaders that will echo throughout modern history, from the underground up.

Introducing Jacob Frye, who with the help of his twin sister Evie, will change the fate of millions in Assassin’s Creed Syndicate. Rise to rally and lead the underworld to break the corrupt stranglehold on London in a visceral adventure filled with action, intrigue, and brutal combat.

Game.name: GTA Long Night
Game.description_short: GTA: Long Night is an arcade horror modification for Vice City, developed by The Fighting Hellfish. After over a year of development, this mod transforms the familiar setting of Vice City into a city besieged by hordes of the undead. The storyline focuses on multiple survivors making their way to the last human stronghold, sharing tales of zombie chaos through over twenty original missions and cutscenes. The mod features new radio stations, particle effects, animations, and more than half a dozen playable characters.

Game.name: GTA Turk City
Game.description_short: GTA Turk City (also known as GTA Türk) is a mod of GTA Vice City

Game.name: Super Mario 64 in GTA San Andreas
GTA: La Heist
Game.description_short: A fan game with the motif of GTA.

Game.name: Prison Life Simulator 2022: World Fight Battle GTA Ultimate
Game.description_short: Simulator with a third-person view. The game takes place in a jail, after a failed bank robbery and a city chase, you arrested for 7 years.

Game.name: Total War: Medieval III
Game.description_short:
Total War: MEDIEVAL III es un videojuego de estrategia a gran escala ambientado en la Edad Media donde, como jugadores, tomamos el control de un reino pudiendo alterar el curso de los acontecimientos históricos con decisiones que impactan el desarrollo de la facción y del mundo a través de la era medieval. 

Por el momento no se conocen todos los detalles de la propuesta, más allá de que sus desarrolladores buscan convertirnos en verdaderos líderes en las batallas, permitiéndonos dominar el impacto de la moral, la disciplina y los campos de batalla cambiantes (como el barro).

Game.name: New Scuffed Bhop Simulation 2026: Goty Edition
Game.description_short: The long-awaited sequel to the hit game New Scuffed Bhop Simulation 2023 (POG Champ) is here! All new SinglePlayer maps with popular maps returning from the first game! Play online multiplayer cross platform with all new modes and experiences!

Game.name: Esports Manager 2026
Game.description_short: Build and lead your own professional esports organization. Scout players, manage contracts, develop talent, hire staff, grow your brand, and compete for championship titles in a deep and realistic management simulation.

Game.name: Business Simulator 2026
Game.description_short: In Business Simulator 2026, you start with a small capital and aim to build a business empire in the city by deciding which business to start in which shop and deciding the prices. Business Simulator 2026 is a business simulation that will test your business acumen and strategic planning skills.

Game.name: eFootball: Mourinho Edition 2026
Game.description_short:
eFootball is a football simulation game developed and published by Konami.

In eFootball: Mourinho Edition 2026, manager José Mourinho appears alongside a new skill, the "Diagonal Long Pass A" Link-up Play. The edition also includes two Highlight players—Son Heung-min and Memphis Depay—who meet the conditions for the Centrepiece and Key Man roles. As a purchase bonus, it provides 150 eFootball Coins.

Game.name: eFootball: Leo Messi Edition 2026
Game.description_short:
eFootball is a football simulation game developed and published by Konami.

eFootball: Leo Messi Edition 2026 includes Lionel Messi as an Epic player, along with seven Highlight players—Chris Wood, Jonathan Clauss, Kevin De Bruyne, Luka Modrić, Nicolás Otamendi, Robert Lewandowski, and Yassine Bounou. The edition also features stadium elements such as the Leo Messi Edition ’26 stadium choreography and the Leo Messi Golden Statue ’26 giant props, as well as eleven 4,000 EXP tokens. As a purchase bonus, it grants 250 eFootball Coins.

Game.name: eFootball: Leo Messi Edition 2026 - Deluxe
Game.description_short:
eFootball is a football simulation game developed and published by Konami.

eFootball: Leo Messi Edition 2026 - Deluxe includes Lionel Messi as an Epic player, along with ten Highlight players—Chris Wood, James Rodríguez, Jonathan Clauss, Kevin De Bruyne, Luka Modrić, Mohamed Salah, Nicolás Otamendi, Robert Lewandowski, Stefan de Vrij, and Yassine Bounou. Additional content includes the Leo Messi Edition 2026 [Deluxe] strip, stadium elements such as the Leo Messi Edition ’26 stadium choreography and the Leo Messi Golden Statue ’26 giant props, three types of Leo Messi Edition 2026 avatar icons, a Leo Messi Edition 2026 avatar background, and twenty-two 4,000 EXP tokens. As a purchase bonus, it grants 450 eFootball Coins.

Game.name: eFootball: Lamine Yamal Edition 2026
Game.description_short:
eFootball is a football simulation game developed and published by Konami.

eFootball: Lamine Yamal Edition 2026 includes Lamine Yamal as an Epic player, along with seven Highlight players—Aleksandar Pavlović, Anatolii Trubin, Benjamin Šeško, Dean Huijsen, Josip Stanišić, Milos Kerkez, and Pedri. Additional content features stadium elements such as the Lamine Yamal Edition ’26 stadium choreography and the Lamine Yamal Golden Statue ’26 giant props, as well as eleven 4,000 EXP tokens. As a purchase bonus, it provides 250 eFootball Coins.

Game.name: eFootball: Lamine Yamal Edition 2026 - Deluxe
Game.description_short:
eFootball is a football simulation game developed and published by Konami.

eFootball: Lamine Yamal Edition 2026 - Deluxe includes Lamine Yamal as an Epic player, along with ten Highlight players—Aleksandar Pavlović, Anatolii Trubin, António Silva, Benjamin Šeško, Dean Huijsen, Josip Stanišić, Milos Kerkez, Nico Williams, Pedri, and Warren Zaïre-Emery. Additional content includes the Lamine Yamal Edition 2026 [Deluxe] strip, stadium elements such as the Lamine Yamal Edition ’26 stadium choreography and the Lamine Yamal Golden Statue ’26 giant props, three types of Lamine Yamal Edition 2026 avatar icons, a Lamine Yamal Edition 2026 avatar background, and twenty-two 4,000 EXP tokens. As a purchase bonus, it grants 250 eFootball Coins.

Game.name: Axis Football 2026
Game.description_short: Axis Football 2026 is a complete American Football Simulation featuring fluid gameplay, endless customization, and the industry's best franchise mode.

Game.name: Draft Day Sports: College Football 2026
Game.description_short: Start as a coordinator and rise to head coach in Draft Day Sports: College Football 26! Build playbooks, recruit stars, manage team cohesion, and outsmart adaptive AI. Create your dynasty with unmatched depth and strategy.

Game.name: PBA Pro Bowling 2026
Game.description: Do you have what it takes to bowl with the greats? PBA Pro Bowling is back and better than ever with a reimagined Career Mode, character customization, new character art, improved graphics, online play, advanced physics, and oil pattern breakdown - plus new game modes, venues, pros, balls, and more!
Game.description_short: Start as a rookie in your hometown league and work your way up to the PBA Pro Tour, collecting new balls and apparel as you climb the ranks. Choose your own path - focus on traditional bowling competitions or branch out into exciting alternative game modes like Strike Derbies or Candlepin Bowling as you progress from local events to the national stage, building your legacy along the way.

Game.name: Pro Basketball Manager 2026
Game.description_short: Lead your club to greatness in Pro Basketball Manager 2026! The Basketball Champions League arrives with 53 licensed teams, putting you in charge of every decision as you aim to dominate both domestic and continental basketball.

Game.name: City Bus Simulator 2026
Game.description_short: Experience the Ultimate Bus Driving Adventure! Step into the driver's seat in City Bus Simulator 2026, the most immersive and realistic bus simulation game. Navigate a sprawling 40 square kilometer city, mastering a variety of bus models with unique features and dynamics.

Game.name: Geo-Political Simulator 2026 Edition
Game.description_short:
Geopolitical Simulator – 2026 Edition is a simulation of our current world, recreating its features in-depth and across a number of domains: economic, political, military, social, financial, environmental, energetic, transportation…
Every country and major multinational corporation are represented with their own variables and functions. The calculation and scenario engines include more than 150,000 facts and figures, 20,000 texts, and 12 hours of recorded dialog. An ultra-detailed and animated 3D map with vegetation, bodies of water, every border, regions, production facilities, and important strategic sites around the world become your playground.

Game.name: mrak!
Game.description_short:
!mrak es un juego de disparos en primera persona con elementos de simulación inmersiva ambientado en un Hokkaido alternativo de 2003, que se convirtió en parte de Rusia a mediados del siglo XX. Un centro tecnológico oculto tras letreros de neón y fachadas oscuras. Aquí, el poder se divide entre corporaciones, agencias de inteligencia y aquellos que permanecen en las sombras.

Eres una herramienta en el juego de alguien. Tu objetivo es encontrar al objetivo, eliminarlo y desaparecer. ¿Cómo? Esa es tu elección. Escabullirte por los tejados, esconderte en las sombras, desactivar las cámaras... o dejar un rastro sangriento detrás.

💥 REQUISITOS DEL SISTEMA

🔥 MÍNIMO:
🔶 SO *: Windows 7
🔶 PROCESADOR: Intel Core i3-7100U
🔶 MEMORIA: 4 GB de RAM
🔶 GRÁFICOS: Intel UHD Graphics 620
🔶 DIRECTX: Versión 11
🔶 ALMACENAMIENTO: 5 GB de espacio disponible

* A partir del 1 de enero de 2024, el cliente de Steam solo será compatible con Windows 10 y versiones posteriores.

Game.name: #7-J5Z: The Driftwood Experiment
Game.description: A simple and short cozy game where you play as an unusual robot, exploring an underwater cave system.
Game.description_short:
Set in a universe where gemstones are abundant... but fauna and flora are scarce.

A robot is sent to a newly found underwater cave to discover the fish and plants that inhabit the area. Sunken driftwood logs containing a fungus, rest on the beds of the cave. This special fungus with unique properties will be key to complete the mission.

Game.name: #AkiRobots
Game.description_short: #AkiRobots is a 2D puzzle platformer where you control multiple characters simultaneously. The game includes 100 levels and players can modify existing levels, create new levels to share and import other players’ levels via the level editing and sharing system.

Game.name: #Archery
Game.description: #Archery brings out your inner archer in a way you have never seen before! Make pizzas, sell ice cream, deliver newspapers and much more - all with bow&arrow like there is no tomorrow!
Game.description_short: Imagine waking up one day and having to do basically everything with a bow and arrow. Crazy right? Well, that is what happened to you and now you need to live your life accordingly. Play your way through your various work days where you sell ice cream to kids, make vegetarian pizzas, deliver newspapers, chop wood, catch fish, destroy someones lawnmower and various other shenanigans. We don’t judge, but we certainly encourage you to destroy EVERYTHING! After all - you’re the master of #Archery​ in VR. Don’t try this IRL.

Game.name: #Blud
Game.description: Save your friends, fight off the vampire apocalypse, and survive the horrors of freshman field hockey practice in #Blud a delightfully zany animated dungeon crawler that blurs the line between action RPGs and hyperkinetic 90s cartoons.
Game.description_short: Slaying the undead is just another day at high school for Becky Brewster, new kid in town and latest in an ancient bloodline of spellcasting vampire hunters. Root out demonic infestations through the town’s buzzing social media, and take selfies with demonic forces to analyze their weaknesses. Power up your trusty fiend-thwacking field hockey stick, and level up your latent magic skills through grimoires and school supplies. Master the slaying game with the help of an eclectic cast of hilarious characters, and teach the vampires a thing or two about messing with Carpentersville High!

Game.name: #CuteSnake
Game.description_short: Let`s help this snake to eat all apples! Nice classic snake game with casual gameplay.

Game.name: EscapeRoomSimulator
Game.description_short:
Escape Room Simulator (Escape Room Sim) es un juego de puzles desarrollado y publicado por Liam Twose para PC. Resuelve acertijos para escapar de habitaciones en solitario o acompañado de otros jugadores en este juego de puzles con físicas avanzadas desde una perspectiva en primera persona, en el que podemos crear nuestras propias escape room gracias a un editor y compartirlas en internet.

Un juego de puzles en escape room, en el que puedes crear tus propios rompecabezas y compartirlos con otros jugadores

Las escape room son un juego y desafios físico y mental en el que los participantes son encerrados en una habitación y deben usar elementos del entorno para resolver una serie de puzles, encontrar pistas y completar objetivos dentro de un tiempo limitado, y que se han puesto muy de moda en los últimos años, pudiendo encontrar en las grandes ciudades varias empresas que se dedican a diseñar y ofrecer este tipo de experiencias. 

Ahora estas aventuras de puzles llegan también a los videojuegos con diferentes tipos de propuestas, como este Escape Room Simulator, centrado en superar escape room, tanto en solitario como en cooperativo junto a otros jugadores, y en el que además podemos diseñar nuestros propios desafíos gracias a sus herramientas de creación.

Desde una perspectiva en primera persona, tendrás que enfrentarte a desafiantes escape room, manipulando objetos con un elaborado sistema de físicas y resolviendo todo tipo de acertijos para poder escapar, con diferentes ambientaciones, como la ciencia ficción, que se irán ampliando poco a poco. 

Centrado inicialmente en la experiencia para un jugador, el juego se ampliarán con multijugador cooperativo y avanzadas herramientas de edición, para que puedas crear tus propias escape room y compartirlas por internet con otros jugadores, desafiando a que superen rompecabezas que has creado, e incluso podrás controlar y supervisar las salas en tiempo real mientras otros juegan, haciendo de maestro de ceremonias.

Game.name: #Funtime
Game.description_short: Pilot an upgradable ship through waves of photorealistic shapes featuring some of the most exotic colors known to man. Swap colors to survive while pumping your favorite tunes and climbing the leaderboard. Are you ready to have a #Funtime?

Game.name: #Have A Sticker
Game.description_short: #Have A Sticker brings loads of fun to the puzzle genre. The goal is simple to combine two pictures by removing the boxes that would overlap. The goal maybe simple but accomplishing it gets trickier and trickier as the left side grows in squares with each level in a set.

Game.name: #IDARB
Game.description_short: Prepare to battle everything from Moustache Cops to Breakfast, in this game inspired by fast action, 8-bit sports and arcade classics! Built with the input of thousands of crazed internet gamers, #IDARB is a chaotic 8-player eSport jumping future arena ball game. Create characters, teams, team logos, tournaments, even your theme music, in this highly customizable experience complete with disruptive “hashbombs” which dynamically change the game itself via Twitch and Twitter! IDARB supports up to a whopping 8 simultaneous local players, and up to 4 vs. 4, head-to-head online matches. Additional features include a mind-blowing single-player story mode, wild half time competitions, and unlockable recipes. Begun as a crowd-sourced project, the game’s title is an acronym for “It Draws a Red Box” (IDARB). Thanks to thousands of suggestions via social media, the game evolved from one red box into the wacky amalgam it is today, complete with hundreds of strange “hashbombs”, secret commands which, when sent to the game via Twitch or Twitter, will disrupt and dynamically change the game in realtime! If there’s something you want that isn’t in #IDARB, it’s probably because you didn’t suggest it, but with so many customization options, you can probably still make it yourself!

Game.name: #Killallzombies
Game.description_short: #Killallzombies is an insane twin-stick zombie shooter with the Twitch streaming interactions, where you surviving hordes of zombies on dynamically changing arena and spectators may affect gameplay via special chat commands.

Game.name: #Notifications
Game.description_short: Just one message can make your life hell.

Game.name: #RunningSnake 2
Game.description_short: #RunningSnake 2 - now with new levels! Let`s help this snake to eat all apples! Nice classic snake game with casual gameplay.

Game.name: #SelfieTennis
Game.description_short:
Take your racket, grab your balls & beat yourself up in a game of #SelfieTennis. Throw the racket
to kill #BallPeople, knock them off the court and take their hearts. Use the #SelfieStick to document your #KillingSpree.

Sincerely, @VRUnicorns

Game.name: #SkiJump
Game.description: #SkiJump - jump like a unicorn in VR! Ski the slopes like a pro and jump higher that you would ever be capable of IRL. Beat your friends in slalom, racing and/or punching villagers (or other players) and/or jumping. #SkiJump has it all (including snow balls).
Game.description_short: #SkiJump lets you SKI & JUMP like a unicorn in virtual reality. Fast paced downhill (and uphill, if you want to work for it), loads of jumping and virtual friends...but beware of the YETI! You can ski forever and you don't even need a lift card <3

Game.name: #WarGames
Game.description_short:
#WarGames is a passive game using an interactive video format that influences the story based on what you chose to watch from a selection of multiple video feeds all playing at the same time.

"The series that watches you.
You shape the story in this thrilling tale of modern espionage, hacking and government conspiracy."

Game.name: $1 Ride
Game.description_short:
$1 Ride is a casual game with a fast paced, timing and reflex testing game-play style.
Travel through space at warp speed! Collect power ups to increase your speed or risk your fuel to collect money, missiles and more.

% is a puzzle game where you have to figure out how to get 12 gauges labeled with Greek letters filled to +100% and -100% respectively.
This is done by changing the cells on the playing field in accordance to the distribution table which is generated in the start of the game.

Game.name: %s, Computer Love
Game.description: %s, Computer Love is a narrative-focused adventure game. You play as Flick, a post-human that explores the universe in hopes of making a friend in a world that has commoditized love and forgotten all about it.
Game.description_short: Flick has not a complete memory. It is a posthuman being, which means it has a computer brain. Each time Flick makes a backup of its mind to free up space, Flick forgets parts of its life. Flick wanders the universe in order to document unknown parts of the cosmos, but what it really wants is to find a friend. It has been centuries since Flick has talked to anyone! One day, when an unknown bug attacks its operative system, Flick falls to the ground in what appears to be a tiny, tiny planet. There, Flick meets a nameless robot that swears it's not alive, and enrolls it in a strange scavenger hunt to (literally) make a friend.
A bizarre role-playing game in an alien landscape where every text consists of unreadable lines and dashes.

Game.name: &: Sora no Mukou de Saki Masuyou ni
Game.description_short: Visual novel about a group of youths attempting to reconnect after witnessing two moons in the sky, reminding them of a similar event from their childhood.

Game.name: (A)woken
Game.description:
Alpha prototype of a mecha first person shooter made in godot.
It features hand drawn anime style character sprites, an endless arcade mode and a single player story mode.
Game.description_short: The theme of the game is being inside of a computer simulation. Both the characters and enemies are programs fighting against each other.

Game.name: (Dis)assemble
Game.description_short: Combine characters with unique abilities in this co-op puzzle game! Together they are stronger, but apart they can be in more than one place at the same time...

Game.name: (Don't) Open Your Eyes
Game.description_short:
You are trying to fall asleep.
In the midst of a silent night, a shadowy being approches your bed.
You can't see it... but across the darkness of your eyelids, a silhuette forms nonetheless.
It seeks one thing: for you to open your eyes, and tell them how they look.
Will you comply? Or will you refuse to see them for what they are?
The choice is yours.

"(Don't) Open Your Eyes" is a short, horror-themed Visual Novel about a midnight encounter with a mysterious being. Through conversation, you'll learn more about them, such as their journey so far, or what they think about themselves. And every now and then, it'll make a simple request out of you: to open your eyes.

It's up to you whether to open your eyes or not. It's up to you to believe if they're really there, or if that whispering voice is only a part of your imagination. Just don't keep your visitor waiting for too long.

Features:

A chilling tale about a creature's eternal search.
Fully-voiced experience.
Choose how the creature looks like at specific points in the story, with up to 27 possible combinations.
Each option provides a new bit of dialogue, so be sure to try them all!
A succint experience, between 30 minutes and 1 hour in length.
Credits:

Writing and programming was done by me, Daniel "Via" Cuturrufo. You can learn more about me by hitting the twitter link on my profile (or here: https://twitter.com/Lumino_Via)
Voice acting provided by the wonderful David Acosta (link to his twitter: https://twitter.com/CardioPen)
Monster design and general art by Carolina Cuturrufo (instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hojasdeabril/)

Game.name: Combat Master: Battle to Death
Game.description_short: Combat Master: Battle to DEATH is a roguelite game with souls-like combat. Battle against hordes of various dark fantasy monsters and try to survive as long as possible. The game fully focuses on combat, pick a class from 6 different classes and start SMASHING!

Game.name: Combat Master
Game.description_short:
Únete a un combate trepidante y lleno de acción. Juega Maestro de combate: la mejor experiencia FPS en tu móvil. El mejor tiroteo multijugador de su clase. Rendimiento de siguiente nivel. Y mucho más.

Ya sea que seas un profesional táctico o simplemente te guste la estética táctica, Maestro de combate ofrece un juego de disparos que se centra en la calidad y la innovación que estás buscando.

RENDIMIENTO DE SIGUIENTE NIVEL

El FPS más rápido del mundo en dispositivos móviles. Rendimiento excepcional con gráficos AAA excepcionales.

- Tiempo de carga ultrarrápido, ¡pasa a la acción en segundos!

- Optimización para dispositivos de gama baja y alta con varias configuraciones disponibles para personalización.

LA EXPERIENCIA MULTIJUGADOR DEFINITIVA

- No hay ventaja para los usuarios que pagan, todos son iguales.
- No se permiten descargas de "actualizaciones diarias".
- Controles e interfaz totalmente personalizables.
- Modo sin conexión.
- Varios mapas con juego vertical, combate cuerpo a cuerpo o a distancia.

TIROTEOS DE PRÓXIMA GENERACIÓN

-Tiroteos de ritmo súper rápido.
-Recorrido de saltos, toboganes y escaladas.
-Cuchillos arrojadizos.
- Animaciones de calidad AAA.
- Impresionante Arsenal.

INNOVACIÓN EN LA RED

Game.name: .Flow
Game.description:
.Flow is one of the most well-known fangames of the original Yume Nikki, made by lol. It's one of the darker spin-offs infamous for its eerie atmosphere and copious amounts of body horror and hospital imagery, centering around a girl named Sabitsuki (さびつき) as she enters her PC dreamworld to explore her mind and collect effects.
.Flow is one of the more traditional fangames that stays true to the gameplay elements of the original. Effects are collected in a gloomy, sublime dreamscape and the user is left to interpret the events and lack of explicit storyline. The only differences that seem to set this game apart from Yume Nikki is the more concrete subject matter (the deeper aspects of the landscape seem to have a more pristine resemblance to human body parts, where as Nikki's environment requires more interpretive thinking to analyze) and the inclusion of three endings instead of one.

The main plot of the game is similar to the original Yume Nikki's, in that it's a sandbox game with very few exploration restrictions. You must collect the twenty-five effects to unlock two of the three endings and three boxes to achieve the third.
Game.description_short: Much like Yume Nikki, little is known about the main protagonist, a girl named Sabitsuki, about whom very little is known. Similar to Madotsuki, the protagonist of Yume Nikki, Sabitsuki lives in an apartment with a bed, a single game console, a television, and most importantly, a personal computer which she uses to enter a state known as "flow." While in flow, Sabitsuki (and the player) enter an surreal immersive reality linked to her psyche which she can explore in order to find 25 "effects." Exactly who Sabitsuki is, what she has gone through, and even what kind of world she lives in is entirely up to the player to interpret based on what they see and experience while in flow.

As in the previous .hack games, .hack//G.U. simulates a massively multiplayer online role-playing game as the player controls a character who starts playing it. Players assume the role of a participant in a fictional game called The World. While in The World, the player controls the on-screen player character, Haseo, from a third-person person perspective (with optional first-person mode). The player may control the camera using the game controller's right analog stick.

Game.name: .Hack//G.U. Vol. 3: Redemption HD
Game.description: .Hack//G.U. Vol. 3: Redemption is the third entry in the .hack//G.U. series containing: Vol. 1: Rebirth, .hack//G.U. Vol. 2: Reminisce and .hack//G.U. Vol. 3: Redemption. As in the previous .hack games, .hack//G.U. simulates a massively multiplayer online role-playing game as the player controls a character who starts playing it. Players assume the role of a participant in a fictional game called The World. While in The World, the player controls the on-screen player character, Haseo, from a third-person person perspective (with optional first-person mode). The player may control the camera using the game controller's right analog stick.
Game.description_short: Within the fictional game, players explore monster-infested fields and dungeons as well as "Root Towns" that are free of combat. They also can "log-off" from the game and return to a computer desktop interface which includes in-game e-mail, news, and message boards, as well as desktop and background music customization options. In Reminisce, an optional card game called "Crimson VS" becomes available. The player may save the game to a memory card both from the desktop and within The World at a Save Shop. After the player completes the game, a Data Flag appears on the save file, which allows the transfer of all aspects of the player character and party members to the next game in the series. This can also be applied to previous games if the player first finished the Reminsce or Redemption. Players can attack monsters in real time. However, the action pauses whenever the menu is opened in order to select magic to cast, items to use, or skills to perform. The player only directly controls Haseo, while the other characters are controlled by artificial intelligence. The player may either provide guidelines ("Free Will", "Rage", "Life", etc.) or issue direct commands (for example, to cast a particular magic at a particular enemy) to the computer-controlled characters. Monsters roam the environments freely or guard treasure chests. Once combat is initiated, via a "surprise attack" or the player being spotted, a wall erects around the combat area to prevent escape. Weapons give the player access to the Skill Trigger feature which allows them to perform a powerful attack at the cost of losing SPs. As an adept rogue character, Haseo can wield multiple weapons for close combat. Although Haseo can only use one weapon per battle, during Reminisce the player can change weapons in the middle of Skill Triggers. Under certain conditions, the player may execute an enhanced type of Skill Trigger called "Rengeki". These attacks deal greater damage and fill a Morale gauge, which allows the player and his team members to use a combination attack. Certain plot-related fights, called "Avatar battles", use a different interface which incorporates shoot 'em up gameplay elements. After depleting the opponent's health, players must charge up a "Data Drain" to end the battle. Root Towns are non-combat areas in The World. The player may restock on items, buy equipment, or chat and trade with other "players" of The World. The player may also undertake optional quests and visit guilds. A key feature of all towns is the Chaos Gate. This blue portal is used to travel between towns (called "servers") as well as access the fields and dungeons where battles take place. A password system controls the characteristics of each area. Depending on the characteristics of each word in the three word phrase, the resulting area may have different attributes such as prevalence of monsters or items, among other features.

Game.name: 0°N 0°W: VR
Game.description_short: A first person surreal exploration adventure of visual auditory stimuli now available in VR! Participate in the early access development process.

You wake up to some radiating emotions floating from the other room... It's a busted memory machine, radiating the world and splitting it in two. It's up to you to find the missing parts of the machine and piece it back together again!

Game.name: 00 mem.: ~Le Chat~
Game.description_short: The main character had a strange and terrifying nightmare. But when he wakes up, he relaxes. It was just a dream. He wakes up in his room and a new carefree day awaits him. But is everything as good as it seems to our hero at first glance?

Game.name: 00:00 Zerotime
Game.description: Escape to the Warpgate on the last remaining rescue shuttle before the shock wave reaches you!
Game.description_short: You are an unnamed pilot escaping an accident. Manage fuel and electricity on your ship to escape from the blast for as much time as possible.

0000 is a hard-as-nails platformer in which you play as a courageous 1-bit cowboy. With your weapon and awesome double jump, your task is to defeat 100 unique levels. Each failure warps you into a new, randomly selected level, until you conquer them all. What awaits those that get to the end?

Best game in the world

An abstract, experimental dystopian game.

Game.name: 0008: The Story
Game.description: A visual novel from German VN.
Game.description_short: This Visual Novel tells a story in which the reader must decide for themselves whether it is true or false ...

Game.name: 001 Earth
Game.description_short: Dimension 001, Arthur's Timeline, It's not reincarnation but you re-live different realities/timelines. Roam biomes, forage, hunt, fight beasts and monsters, clear dungeons, fight the Demon King and an Omnipotent God

Game.name: 007 First Light
Game.description_short: Earn the Number. 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Follow James Bond as a young, resourceful, and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training programme, and discover an origin story of the world’s most famous spy.

Game.name: 007 Legends
Game.description_short:
007 Legends features an original, overarching storyline tying together six classic Bond movies for an original James Bond experience, and equips players with state-of-the-art spy gadgets, an arsenal of weapons and more.

In addition to 007 Legends' main story, the game features the return of fan-favorite single-player Mi6 Ops Missions, which debuted in GoldenEye 007: Reloaded and challenges players to complete extra missions ranging from all-out action to stealth and gadget-based gameplay and compete for the highest online leader board scores. Also for the first time ever, players will be able to participate as one of Bond's cohorts or villainous foes, reliving the missions through their eyes, as well as 007's. Meanwhile the robust James Bond multiplayer experience includes local four-player split-screen game modes and online competitive gameplay with new maps, weapons and characters derived from Bond's 50 year legacy. With more gadgets, deeper stealth and spy investigation gameplay, gamers will have every opportunity to truly feel like the world's favorite spy.

Game.name: 007 Legends: Eve
Game.description: Play as Eve from the SKYFALL movie. Unlock the playable character Eve available for use in Splitscreen and Multiplayer Mode. To use this download, you will need 007 Legends.
Game.description_short:
Taking place after the opening but prior to the events of Skyfall, James Bond is shot and left for dead during a botched assignment in Istanbul. As his life hangs in the balance, he begins to remember his previous adventures — foiling Operation Grand Slam, the assault on Piz Gloria, his vendetta against drug kingpin Franz Sanchez, his encounter with Gustav Graves, and thwarting billionaire industrialist Hugo Drax's plot to kill the entire human race. Straight after his return to the present day, Bond realizes that he's still alive. He tracks down Patrice, whom he was after in the very beginning of the game, to Shanghai where he stops an assassination plot and eliminates the hitman.

The game presents a What if? scenario where all of the "classic" Bond adventures have taken place during the six-year gap between the storylines of Quantum of Solace and Skyfall.

Game.name: 007 Legends: Patrice
Game.description_short: Play as the villain Patrice from the SKYFALL movie. Unlock the playable character Patrice available for use in Splitscreen and Multiplayer Mode. To use this download, you will need 007 Legends.

Game.name: 007 Legends: Skyfall
Game.description_short: Take on the role of James Bond as played by Daniel Craig in all new SKYFALL levels. Unlock three new single player levels following the storyline of the SKYFALL movie. Levels take place in Istanbul and Shanghai as the player (Bond) attempts to track down the villain Patrice.

Game.name: 007: Licence to Spell Doom
Game.description_short:
007: Licence to Spell Doom is a nine-level Ultimate Doom mapset for ZDoom by Stephen Clark (The Ultimate DooMer). It was released on December 24, 2002.

The player takes on the role of '007', a "Special Secret Service" agent (stated to be the protagonist of Stephen Clark's previous WADs, Fragport and Operation: Lightning). 007's mission is to assault the facilities of a terrorist organization called MISSILE, who are allied with the forces of Hell.

Game.name: 007: Sonic Secret Agent
Game.description_short: 007: Sonic Secret Agent is a video game published in 2003 on Windows. It's an action game, set in an arcade, platform and fan made themes.
The game consists of finishing several levels, solving by clicking with the mouse or using the keyboard to complete the tasks.

Game.description_short: This DLC includes another 10 bonus Classic levels, extremely cool, which will make you love the game even more.
