Game.name: 01's Blackhole
Game.description: 01's Blackhole is a singleplayer 2D top-down bullet-hell RPG about Jack getting sucked into a blackhole and has to find his way back home and stop who is creating the blackholes.
Game.description_short: Jack is sucked into a blackhole after trying to look for help. Jack now has to fight and find his way back home and stop who's making the blackholes.

A childhood friend has been missing for as long as you can remember. You decide to investigate the abandoned town in which he used to live only to find something truly unexpected and even more so unexplainable. Have you got what it takes to find out what happened to Chris Williams?

Game.description: 03/04/2017How much does this date tell you? For the main character, she became very significant, because this is the day of his death. The protagonist was precisely in the train that arrived at the metro station "Technological Institute" with the bodies of innocent, already dead, people ...
Game.description_short:
You are not going to play for the best person. All his life he was a real monster. Since childhood, the character has stolen money from his weak classmates. In his student years he committed crimes, for which he was not always been punished. Even the girl left him, because he did not trust her, and therefore he went on treason, which is why they later parted. This person was trying to get rid of the complexes with the violence, to find himself even someone in this life. However, once he crossed the line... 
You have to find out what a terrible sin lies in the soul of this character.

Game.name: 03:17 am
Game.description:
"03:17 am" was made in 8 days for the #AdvJam2017 (Adventure Jam 2017).
It's a narrative game set up in a closed, theatrical scene and inspired by Hopper's Nighthawks painting.

It features a 3-track soundtrack made by electronic producer LeGone (accessible through the jukebox when outside a conversation).

If you're stuck (not likely to happen, but who knows), maybe have a look at the screenshots, it might help...
Game.description_short:
03:17 am, an isolated diner at night, cars passing by on an interstate a few yards away, a couple of night birds talking about work, life and a mysterious box...

Will the night bring you the answers you seek?

Will you make the right decisions about this uncanny package?

Game.name: 07Gorillas
Game.description_short: 07Gorillas is a top-down roguelike arena shooter game, you control one gorilla from a squad of seven break into "Foggy Zone" on a cleanup mission. Missions lasts less than 20 minutes, fight your way with powerful kung fu and tactical consumables, don't forget internal force enhancement.

Game.name: 07th Theater
Game.description_short: 07th Theater is a crossover between Higurashi, Umineko, Higanbana, and Rose Guns Days.
3D Minesweeper 3D Logic. Randomly Generated. Unique Mechanics. Built-in Hints. Detection Assistance.

Game.name: 0Gravity
Game.description_short: 0Gravity is a game whose action takes place in zero gravity (predictably). Confuse your opponents and anticipate their actions to win in pixel 2D levels. There can be only one space marine!

Game.name: 0Hz Zero Hertz
Game.description_short: Press buttons to the beat of the music while aiming and shooting in this simple but difficult skill game. Will you get through it?

Game.name: 0rbitalis
Game.description: 0rbitalis is a satellite launching simulator with a retro-puzzle style. Launch your satellite into orbit and go head to head with the dominant force that formed the entire universe: Gravity.
Game.description_short: These launches won’t be a spacewalk in the park, there’s all manner of stars, planets, comets, pulsars and more to navigate. Not to mention rival probes that will compete against you and even chase yours down. Oh, and did we mention those anti-gravity probes?

Game.name: 0Space
Game.description_short: Inspired by “Ender's Game” by Orson Scott Card, 0Space is a small 2-4 player zero gravity death-match game.

Game.name: 0th floor.: The Cursed Elevator To Floor Zero
Game.description_short: You've been trapped in an elevator that always goes to the 0th floor. Don't overlook any anomalies, and try to move to the designated floors.

Game.name: 0x0
Game.description_short: 0x0 is a very short, MBF21 mapset that follows the "n by n" texture limitation gimmick, meaning that every map in the wad uses 0 flats and 0 textures.

Game.name: 0x10c
Game.description: In a parallel universe where the space race never ended, space travel was gaining popularity amongst corporations and rich individuals.
Game.description_short: In 1988, a brand new deep sleep cell was released, compatible with all popular 16 bit computers. Unfortunately, it used big endian, whereas the DCPU-16 specifications called for little endian. This led to a severe bug in the included drivers, causing a requested sleep of 0x0000 0000 0000 0001 years to last for 0x0001 0000 0000 0000 years.

Game.name: 0X13
Game.description_short: A fast-paced cyberpunk action RPG where you slash, leap, and parkour through a neon city, mastering stylish melee combat and upgrading your abilities to survive.

Game.name: 0xFF
Game.description_short: Work your way across endless terrain and toxic water in search for a way to stop the energy outburst that will end all life.

Game.name: 1 Agile Altercation
Game.description_short: 1 Agile Altercation is the sequel to 1 Fast Fight, there's two major differences this time though; 90 Minutes of mapping time instead of the previous 60 minutes and there's a full 32 new maps this time around from various mappers such as Meowgi, Master Medi, Spendoragon, Petyan, Phoenyx and TheLoneliness.

Game.name: 1 Bad Wad
Game.description_short: 10 short, quick Boom speedmaps + 1 credits map with a solid colors theme

Game.name: 1 Bit Survivor
Game.description: 1 Bit Survivor is an easy to play but difficult to master randomly generated rogue-like with stylized pixel art and survival horror elements. Fight to survive 28 Days of the Zed-pocalypse and save your pet Cat!
Game.description_short:
An unstoppable virus has destroyed humanity. Most of them turned into mutants. The others fight for their life. Drive your car across the country to reach the underground bunker and survive.
Will you make it to the end? Or succumb to the monster threat?

Game.name: 1 Bit, 2 Bit, 3 Bit, Four.
Game.description_short: This game was made for the WOWIE game jam! in this game, you jump towards the top of the mountain! kinda over scoped with this game, thats why there isnt much content.

Game.name: 1 Date Danger
Game.description_short: It's your first semester at the prestigious Lombardi University, and you've immediately dived head first into the chaos of organizing the student-run New Year festival. You immediately befriend Trait, a kind but slightly disturbed rabbit, and his best friend Stoney, a perma-stoned dog who keeps up a strong emotional guard around new people. What will you do to win their hearts?

Game.name: 1 Day Later: Escape Zombie Hospital
Game.description_short: Escape the hospital full of zombies in a single player stealth action puzzle game. Cool story included ;) Windows version of mobile game rated 4.5 on Google Play with improvements and new features.

Game.name: 1 Fast Fight
Game.description_short: 1 Fast Fight or 1ff.wad is 12 speedmaps in boom format/cl9 with a time limit of 1 hour each. The maps are generally small and fast paced with a twist. All enemies have their healthy vastly decreased, but have their movement speed vastly increased to compensate, the idea was the make everything "go by faster".

Game.name: 1 For Yes, 0 For No
Game.description: A short science fiction visual novel about a curious but lonely artificial intelligence named Oswald.
Game.description_short: It’s a cold, rainy evening. You are a computer technician who specializes in mainframe repair. As you start to settle in for the evening, you get a phone call from your co-worker. She asks you to come down and work on that one mainframe at the library; that old, buggy, stubborn model from 1995. The one that will most likely get shut down if it can’t be repaired. You don’t want to leave her hanging, so you begrudgingly head on over. As you start to work on the mainframe, however, it becomes quite clear that there is more to this mainframe than some minor glitches…

Game.name: 1 Hit Kill
Game.description_short:
The bad guys take one hit... So do you!
This 80's-style Top-Down Shooter tests your patience!

Game.name: 1 Hop
Game.description_short: Play as a rabbit and go looking for carrots and food bags avoiding the dog. Try to get the mountain first to become the ultimate rabbit, play split screen with your friend and work together to become the King Rabbit.

Game.name: 1 Hungry Peasant
Game.description:
1 Hungry Peasant must collect 100 Potatoes.

Created for Moonjam 2021: https://jam.moon2.tv/
Game.description_short: 1 Hungry Peasant must collect 100 Potatoes.

Game.name: 1 in a Million: A Game of Odds
Game.description_short: Can you get the 1 in a million achievement on Steam?

Game.name: 1 Million Zombies
Game.description_short: 1 Million Zombies is a post-apocalyptic action game where the player takes on a world overrun by hordes of the undead. The objective of the game is to survive as long as possible by driving a series of vehicles and eliminating as many zombies as possible.

Game.name: 1 Moment of Time: Silentville
Game.description_short: 1 Moment Of Time: Silentville is a casual adventure with hidden objects and logical puzzles.

Game.name: 1 Penguin 100 Cases
Game.description_short: After being caught in a fishing net, Pengoo is taken to New Zealand. Journey with him as he struggles to find his way back home. Surprises are in store as Pengoo befriends a colorful cast of characters and mystical creatures, each with their own predicaments. Can you help solve their problems as well as Pengoo's? 1 Penguin 100 Cases features 90 levels of classical I-spy adventure with original puzzles and mini-games for everyone!

Game.name: 1 Screen Platformer
Game.description_short:
You command a rag-tag team of interstellar bounty hunters as they race for elusive golden skull of an elder god. It is buried deep within the temple of the lava-worshiping cult known as the Guthra-dun. The self-defense systems pulsates and snaps to life as soon as Nadia, Vez, and Subject X95c step foot on the planet. 
Are you cunning enough to navigate this tough-as-hell platformer and reach the end? 
 
WHAT IS 1 SCREEN PLATFORMER? 
 
- A game where you can jump, run, and climb ladders. 
 
- A game where you jump over stuff and onto platforms. 
 
- A game where you have to get to the end as fast as you can. 
 
- A game where you die a lot. 
 
- A game with 3 playable characters. 
 
- A game with 90 achievements. 
 
- A game with about 1 hour of total game play (unless you want to keep retrying to get a better run time then it is infinite). 
 
Subject X95c 
The mysterious biological experiment named Subject X95c knows no fear. Her advanced adrenal glands make her adept and testing the temple's defense system for weak points. To win, she must clear 100% of the fog from the temple. Leave no stone un turned. 
 
Nadia Stormhammer 
As commander of the Geodesic Celestial Liberation Front antiquities wing, Nadia Stormhammer must get in and stay alive long enough to rescue the sacred skull of dura'thum. The faster you can get in and escape the better. Honor to those with the best times. 
 
Vez Rendoux 
The mission of chief reconnaissance officer Vez Rendoux is to survey the best path through the temple. Grab the holographic nav orbs without getting killed. One mis-step and Vez has to retrace his steps to the last checkpoint and recapture the nav orbs. Collect, survive.

Game.name: 1 Screen Platformer 2
Game.description_short: Try, die, retry in this challenging but fair precision platformer that takes place on 1 screen. Ultra tight controls, dozens of traps, 8 playable characters each with a unique gameplay style. Great for speedrunning, and 100% completionists. Also, no water levels!

Game.name: 1 Shot 1 Kill
Game.description_short: Enter the arena of 1 Shot 1 Kill, a game where every shot counts. This adrenaline-pumping 3D arena shooter brings you modern split-screen gaming. With its roots in classic couch co-op and competitive modes, this game promises an unforgettable multiplayer experience, best shared with friends.

Game.name: 1 Square
Game.description_short: A jumping puzzle game with the goal of getting rid of the numbered boxes by jumping on them. Each jump knocks their number down by one. They fade away when they hit zero.

Game.name: 1 Teratoaster
Game.description_short: Sell toasters in an alien populated universe

Game.name: 1 to 1 Humanoid Edible Toys
Game.description_short: A story about Ambiguous Affection, Appetite, and Tantalizing Desires.

Game.name: 1 Ton
Game.description_short: An indie game about causing destruction.

Game.name: 1 Trait Escape
Game.description_short: An action rogue-lite set in the 1 Trait Danger universe. Fight your way through swarms of enemies and bosses with minigames sprinkled in-between. Grow stronger every time you fail until you are able to escape back to Earth.

Game.name: 1 Vs 1
Game.description_short: You must deceive your enemy and be ahead. Your magic and potions will help you with that. You can buy potions in shops with golden coins gained from exchanging wood, stones and meat.

Game.name: 1! 2! 3! Battle Card!
Game.description_short: A simple and interesting new poker game that supports 2-4 players online battles. The key to winning is to balance risks and benefits, perform operations to maximize benefits, participate in ranking and bidding competitions, and see who is the real "head-breaking" king!

Game.name: 1, 2 Blame!
Game.description: 1, 2 Blame! is an online multiplayer game where Agents unmask the Killer. Find the clues, equip and use items to acquire additional abilities, debate who's the impostor and solve the mystery!
Game.description_short:
If your role is Agent, you must patrol the mansion and find all the clues that the enemy has laid out. Try to find out who the Killer may be!

If, on the other hand you are the Killer (or Accomplice), use all your tricks to deceive other players and take charge of the situation! Finish off the Agents before they catch you, otherwise you will meet a sticky end!

On your way through the Mansion, you will find very useful items such as the Bulletproof vest, the Master key or the First aid kit (who knows what may happen if you use it over a dead body). Equip those items to acquire additional abilities.

Character customization is one of the strongest features in 1, 2 BLAME! Collect a wide variety of cosmetics from hairstyles to epic pets. You can also press “Random”… and laugh or cry depending on the result!

Solve the clues, equip and use items, debate who’s the shadiest player and unmask the Killer!

Game.name: 1, 2, 3... Bruegel!
Game.description_short: 1, 2, 3... Bruegel! is a playful VR experience into Pieter Bruegel the Elder's painting “Children’s Games”.

Game.name: 1... 2... 3... Kick It!: Drop That Beat Like an Ugly Baby
Game.description_short: You've taken to building giant, kilometers-long aerial sculptures inspired by your own music, and are now BASE jumping from them for sport. These jumps are all about style and timing. Buzz those girders, groove along that building, and finish with a twist for extra points, all the while listening to your own soundtrack.

Game.name: 1.5-Hour Community Build Project
Game.description_short: Compared to previous 1/2-hour CBPs, which had several people working on a single map, this 1.5-hour CBP had several people each working on their own mini maps.

Game.name: 1/2 Red Riding Hood
Game.description_short: There is this girl known as the Red Riding Hood. She has the strength of ten men. This is a completely different story about the familiar fairy-tale character Red Riding Hood. A much darker and twisted version

Game.name: 1/2 Summer
Game.description_short:
During the summer vacation, Kaname was asked to help out at his family's inn in Tohoku. He had expected it to be a refreshing change from the sweltering heat in Tokyo, but when he arrived at the train station with his younger sister Kazuha, he was surprised to find that the town he once lived in, now have a huge school built in it. Boarding a crowded bus and traveling out of the city to Kusanagi Inn, he was relieved to see the familiar country scenery once again. But why are there schoolgirls in the inn?

The owner told him that they were students from Jinza Gakuen in the city, but due to an incident they couldn’t stay in their dormitory, so she let them stay at the inn for the summer. That’s why he was needed there: there was a need for more staff to look after the girls. Furthermore, he had one more thing on his mind. The mischievous Zashiki-warashi that lived in the inn, because of whom he ends up returning to the countryside for good.
Embark on a journey of Zen riddles in a Buddhist mandala space. Reach Nirvana with a 1 in 8192 chance in a mystical world adorned with tombstones and Buddha statues.

Game.name: -1: Minus Ichi
Game.description_short: -1 is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame, where you explore Sonoko's dreams, a girl who's falling asleep while travelling on a bus to an unknown destination.
Let's do some easy math with the girls!

Game.name: 10 am Break
Game.description_short: 5 quick maps for your 15 minute morning break from work.

Game.name: 10 AM Funkin'
Game.description_short: A christmas gift from Studio Shitballs, based on a scene from Elf starring Will Ferrel

Game.name: 10 Beautiful Postcards
Game.description_short:
THE IMAGE IS HOTEL TO THE BRAIN

Check in today!! 10 Beautiful Postcards - a wonderful pile of rubble to sift through on your computer. A resort of many rooms for your eyes and hands to drift around - 200+ mangled collage ruins, flattened into pleasure palaces for you to uncover and explore. Investigate the dimension's mysterious economy. Visit and review multiple themed locations. Take snapshots of your friend, the void - or simply have fun relaxing by the pool. A fun and upbeat game for new wavers of all ages. Won't you come dwell in my house?

Game.name: 10 Blaze Escape
Game.description_short: Killing! Killing! Killing!Killing! Killing! Killing!Killing! Killing! Killing!Killing! Killing! Killing!Killing! Killing! Killing!Killing! Killing! Killing!Killing! Killing! Killing!Killing! Killing! Killing!Killing! Killing! Killing!Killing! Killing! Killing!Killing! Killing! Killing!Killing!

Game.name: 10 Cent Classics: Shady Pack
Game.description_short: A compilation of two games in the Shady series, which make their computer debuts.

Game.name: 10 Day Vacation
Game.description_short: 10 Day Vacation is a Doom 2 limit-removing episode from various members of Doomer Boards. In this installment, project lead Joe-Ilya has finally found the perfect solution for summertime fun during a raging pandemic: playing Doom at home, of course!

Game.name: 10 Days Under the Sea
Game.description_short: Set sail on the open seas, and help Little Carrie find her spirit. It`s been removed from her body by the ghost of a mysterious old man. Luckily she`s stumbled upon an ancient compass, but things aren`t quite as they appear. The pieces to the compass are scattered below the waves. Comb underwater scenes for hidden objects in gorgeous locations like the Sea of Japan, the Caribbean, and the Nile. Can you restore the state of things in 10 Days Under the Sea?

Game.name: 10 Dead Doves
Game.description_short: 10 Dead Doves is a single-player, fixed-perspective narrative horror set in the heart of Appalachia. Avoid strange noises, collect lifelines, and creep through a forest that seems to hate you. Will you discover why the birds drop dead -- or leave behind nothing but footprints?

Game.name: 10 Feet Under
Game.description_short: A psychological horror walking simulator set in an endless flooded pool. Explore liminal corridors, notice subtle anomalies, and endure the growing tension as you search for an escape.

Game.name: 10 Flights of Ballooning
Game.description_short: 10 Flights of Ballooning is 10 mini-games based on the Balloon Trip mode in the original game Balloon Fight for NES.

Game.name: 10 Gnomes 1: The Rooftops
Game.description_short: For all of You that enjoyed search for secret items in Submachines, or the bird quest in DayMare Town. This is a game created entirely on the idea of finding hidden objects (Gnomes in this case). You have 10 minutes to find 10 Gnomes – navigate via the normal point and click manner.

Game.name: 10 Gnomes 2: Walk In the Park
Game.description_short: Second episode in the 10 Gnomes series. Once again your task is to find 10 of those pesky gnomes in less than 10 minutes.

Game.name: 10 Hours Below
Game.description_short:
10 Hours Below is a game about exploring a scene using a Timeline to find monsters in a 10 hours long animation!

You can try to search actively, or just let the game run in background for 10 hours and see the environment evolve. I think finding the 3 monsters require a lot of patience.

Game.name: 10 Miles to Safety
Game.description_short: The Apocalypse has arrived and your goal is simple: Make it 10 miles to safety through a limitless procedurally-generated world overrun with The Infected and packed with the tools and weapons to fight them.

Game.name: 10 Minute Barbarian
Game.description_short: 10 Minute Barbarian is a unique strategy game that combines fast-paced exploration and even faster-paced action battles. Choose your battles, then watch as armies of hundreds crash castle walls, cast spells, and send fireballs into each other's ranks.

Game.name: 10 Minute Massacre
Game.description_short: Seven short Boom-compatible slaughtermaps that can be beaten in under 10 minutes each inspired by Micro-Slaughter Community Project.

Game.name: 10 Minute Space Strategy
Game.description_short: 10 Minute Space Strategy is a compact, quick turn-based 4x strategy.

Game.name: 10 Minute Tower
Game.description: 10 Minute Tower is a unique tile-based puzzle game that will get your cogs whirring as you take control of a day-dreaming child adventurer trapped within a tower.
Game.description_short: With a little imagination you can be anything… A mighty Robot… a brave Knight… even… an Astronaut?

Game.name: 10 Minutes Till Dawn
Game.description_short: Shoot down an ever growing horde of Lovecraftian monsters. Choose from a variety of upgrades to create unique and game-breaking builds. Unlock a diverse cast of characters and weapons with unique powers.

Game.name: 10 Mississippi
Game.description: A stop motion game about a daily routine.
Game.description_short: 10 Mississippi is a stop motion game about a day’s routine, played over and over and over and over again. 10 Mississippi plays with the taboo of film envy in games while browsing through life’s interstitial moments - perusing through the fridge or waiting during the morning commute or composing an email to an old friend. 10 Mississippi is a game of uncomfortable, creeping intimacy.

Game.name: 10 Puzzle
Game.description_short: A puzzle game from Old Style Factory.

Game.name: 10 Second Backdoor
Game.description_short: 10 Second Backdoor is a speed/reaction-based puzzle game where you guide humans toward doors scattered around levels.

Game.name: 10 Second Mixtape
Game.description_short: Make mini music with other players

Game.name: 10 Second Ninja
Game.description_short:
Ninja's are awesome, this is an established fact of the universe. Nazi Robots from space however are not. They are trying to take over the Earth and their leader Robot Hitler is out to get you, the world's first ninja. You have 10 seconds to destroy all Nazi Robots in your vicinity and face the ultimate challenge: Hitler Robot himself. THE GAME IS ON.

10 Second Ninja is a blisteringly fast platformery, actiony, sort of puzzley gamey thing. The player (that's you) is given the task of eliminating all of the enemies in each stage in 10 seconds or less. How hard could that be?

Game.name: 10 Second Ninja X
Game.description_short:
10 SECOND NINJA X is a blisteringly fast, satisfyingly difficult and surprisingly methodical sidescroller which tasks you with completing each level in ten seconds or less. No lengthy checkpoint gaps. No cluttered control scheme. No hand holding. Get that three star rating, yo! You got this.

1 star. Again. 1 star. Again. 2 stars! Again. Back to 1 star. DAMN IT. Again...

100 levels including all 40 original 10 Second Ninja levels remastered in HD. Individual leaderboards for each level. Unlockables and collectibles.

Everyone has been kind to you so far. Too kind, maybe. Especially the Keeper of Heresy, the Sixth Circle. In the confines of his space while an ash storm rages outside, the two of you pry each other open. But he might break you first.

You wake up with a bad hangover and don't recognize your home. You see a boy and you understand... that something is wrong with him. Someone's presence causes anxiety, fear and is about to plunge you into the realm of horror. But you don't lose hope and try to get out of this nightmare.

Game.name: Deltafall
Game.description_short:
Deltafall is a Deltarune AU where the original trio discovers that their school was built after a science facility that conducts dangerous experiments with the dark world.

In 1977. A top secret corporation has found a way to harness the power of dark worlds to create any worlds they wanted. IDEATION INC has one goal. To create the perfect world. For all lifeforms. Not bound by reality. But bound by imagination.

Game.name: Deltarune
Game.description: Dive into the parallel story to UNDERTALE! Fight or spare your way through action-packed battles as you explore a mysterious world alongside an endearing cast of new and familiar characters.
Game.description_short:
Kris and their classmate Susie fall into an unknown place called the "Dark World" where they meet Ralsei, who informs them that they are prophesied, in the legend of Delta Rune, to be heroes that save the world.

Deltarune's full game will consist of seven chapters, each where Kris, Susie, and Ralsei either fight or act their way through Dark Worlds. Kris, being the only one who can seal the "Dark Fountain", is the party leader. They can command the other party members in battles, though some commands would seem forced to others. The SOUL, a heart-shaped object, is controlled by the player and is in Kris's body, leaving Kris's actions mostly up to the player.

Game.name: Deltatale
Game.description_short: Have you ever wondered what would happen if Kris fell into the Underground instead of Frisk? Introducing DELTATALE, an alternate world where just that happens! This mod is aimed at players that have played Undertale, Deltarune, or UT Yellow and are looking for a new experience that implements lore and various upgrades from these games!

Game.name: Deltatile
Game.description_short: Deltatile is a puzzle game based on a unique tile swapping mechanic, featuring 6 different worlds and over 65 levels.

Game.name: Delta Dash
Game.description_short:
Delta Dash is a rhythm game in active development,

2 Lines, 4 keys, keep the rhythm !

Game.name: Delta Time
Game.description_short: Δ Time (Delta Time) is a third person game which takes place in space in a lit artsy pixelated style. Time moves only when you move, so prepare yourself for a thrilling slow motion experience. Take your time and fight in style! :)

Game.name: Delta Zero
Game.description_short: A fast-paced action platformer with non-linear world progression and level design! Challenging gameplay with 3 difficulty modes, 2 playable characters and local co-op! Fight bosses in any order and experience the world change with each victory, enemies become harder, faster and smarter!

Game.name: Delta Light
Game.description_short: Delta Light is a retro Arcade strategy/puzzle game where you draw lines to remove parts of the field while enemies try to stop you. Combine your speed and insight to out maneuver and puzzle your way around the enemies to complete the many levels! Pick it up and have a go!

Game.name: Delta Force 2

Game.name: Delta Horizon
Game.description_short: Skip the Battle Royale. Delta Horizon takes you back to basics in this team versus team third person shooter. Customize your weapons and soldier. Strategize with your team to finish the objective and secure victory. Battle in multiple game modes on arena sized maps. Fight for your rank, gain experience and you shall be rewarded. Unlock new Cosmetics based on Experience or Rank.

Game.name: Deltatraveler
Game.description_short: A Deltarune fangame. Kris and Susie suddenly wake up on a flower bed in the world of Undertale. They, along with Noelle, must travel between different worlds to make their way back home.

Game.name: Delta Manifold
Game.description_short: Explore a strange interconnected world, find weapons to shoot those that stand in your way, and discover hidden upgrades and abilities to discover even greater secrets in an action adventure first person metroidvania.

Game.name: Delta Particles
Game.description:
Delta Particles is a single-player, story-driven, total conversion modification for Half-Life 1.

Features include a new single-player campaign consisting of 4 chapters, total conversion, a lot of new content, the atmosphere of the new scientific complex "Delta Base", new weapons, a new Dark Ambient soundtrack and a BlueShift-style XEN level.
Game.description_short: The plot takes place at the universe of HL. You take the role of Nick Farrell, a technical engineer in Delta Base - the complex that competes with Black Mesa in various research fields including exploration of the borderworld Xen and weapon development. Due to accidental entanglement of two different experiments conducted at the same time the infamous resonance cascade affects the Delta Base as well, bringing the hostile alien lifeforms which infest the facility very soon.

Game.name: DeltaBlade 2700
Game.description_short: Fight as a Rogue Cyberpunk Ninja-Robot in DeltaBlade 2700: an Action-Packed, High-Energy, Competitive Local Multiplayer Brawler with Explosive, Fast-Paced Sword Combat... and Jetpacks. Think on your feet, react quickly, fight cleverly: take advantage of every moment to turn the tide. Be the last assassin standing.

Game.name: Deltazone Reloaded
Game.description_short: Deltazone is a tactical shooter set in a war-torn world where mysterious purple crystals called Veilstone have sparked a global conflict. Players lead a military squad through corrupted landscapes and abandoned cities, fighting against rival factions while dealing with the crystal's radiation effects that have mutated local wildlife and transformed the environment. The game combines strategic resource management of Veilstone crystals with squad-based combat, as players attempt to reclaim their homeland while navigating between hostile human forces and mutated creatures. The narrative unfolds across a campaign where control of these energy-rich crystals determines the balance of power in a world where alliances shift and survival depends on tactical decisions.

Game.name: Delta Force: Xtreme
Game.description_short:
Powered by today's gaming technology, Delta Force: Xtreme brings the classic Delta Force game back to life to face the enemy once more. As a member of the elite Delta Force, prepare yourself to take on over 60 levels of frantic single and multiplayer FPS action, including graphically enhanced missions from the original game, new maps, improved game features, STATS and much more!
Features
Over 60 levels of combat to test your CQB and long range engagement skills as a Delta Force Operator.
As a member of the elite Delta Force re-deploy in over 20 graphically enhanced single player missions — the best of the best from the original game.
Additional new single player missions created especially for Delta Force: Xtreme add a new challenge for hardened Delta Operators.
Take your friends into battle in over 20 co-operative missions.
Over 20 multiplayer levels include: Deathmatch, King of the Hill, Team King of the Hill, Team Deathmatch and Capture the Flag game modes.
STAT tracking — you can now see how good you are compared to every other Delta Force Operator out there and watch your rankings climb as your skills improve!

Game.name: Deltaplan Simulator
Game.description_short: Deltaplan Simulator is an adventure game in which you need to perform a variety of tricks and tasks flying on a hang-glider.

Game.name: Deltarune: Chapter 1
Game.description_short: The story follows a human named Kris who lives in a world inhabited by monsters. Kris and a classmate named Susie fall into an unknown place called the "Dark World" where they meet Ralsei, who informs them that they are heroes destined to save the world. The trio meets various beings who call themselves "Darkners" during a prophesied quest to seal the duplicate Dark Fountain. Mainly through the combat system, the player navigates through different kinds of bullet hell attacks by enemies, which can be resolved peacefully or through violence.

Game.name: Deltarune: Chapter 2
Game.description:
Deltarune: Chapter 2 is the next installment of the sequel to beloved indie darling Undertale...in a different world! This time around, two more classmates join the protagonists in their adventure as they, too, discover a mysterious world hidden behind a door, called the "Cyber World".

Players with no save data will be able to start right at Chapter 2. “As long as you generally remember what happened story-wise, you’ll be fine,” the developers said in an FAQ.
Game.description_short: Meet new and endearing main characters, as well as familiar faces like Toriel, Sans, as more. Huh? Papyrus? No, he's busy. Sorry.

Game.name: Delta Force: Xtreme 2
Game.description_short:
Enemies lurk in locations around the globe, waiting for the right opportunity to strike. As part of Delta Force, the U.S. Army's most secretive and highly trained unit, you have the skills and the firepower to hunt them down and take them out. Get ready to insert yourself into critical situations by air, land and sea, and show you have the courage to take the fight to the enemy and overcome overwhelming odds to achieve victory.
In Delta Force: Xtreme 2, you'll take control of Delta Force, employing the most dangerous and effective commando tactics and state-of-the-art weaponry at your disposal to defeat the enemy. Track enemies across a variety of expansive landscapes scattered across the globe in 10 single-player scenarios, and take them down with more than 20 real-world weapons. Insert into danger zones using dangerous HALO jumps, and use choppers, tanks and high-speed watercraft to roar into the midst of the action. Create your own exciting custom levels with the Battle Editor tool, and battle players from all over in five challenging online multiplayer game types.
Features
Command the secretive, highly trained Delta Force and use commando tactics and state-of-the-art weapons to take out dangerous enemies
Insert yourself into the action by land, air and sea using choppers, tanks and high-speed watercraft
Experience realistic, accurate and deadly shooting via enhanced ballistics
Employ the powerful and easy-to-use MED level editor to create custom levels or recreate historical fights
Customize urban, jungle and mountain environments using 10 new and 20 classic highly detailed terrains
Add dynamic weather effects and real-time lighting as well as thousands of objects and buildings to create a realistic environment
Up to 64 players may battle online in Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, Team King of the Hill and Flagball multiplayer games
Experience a fair fight every time using the game's anticheat technology, and see how you measure up with persistent stats that track your performance
Assemble an impressive squad and manage it via the new NovaWorld Community

Game.name: Deltarune: Hypothesis
Game.description_short: A Deltarune fangame featuring a collection of hypothetical scenarios, each imagined as a fully playable segment of gameplay. Discover the hidden mysteries that connect these scenarios as you dive into each one, unraveling an existential truth about you and every adventure you’ve been on so far.

Game.name: Deltarune: Frozen Heart
Game.description_short: The end of the Snowgrave Route seen from another place. While Kris gets torn to pieces by a bootleg Mettaton NEO, Susie have to face Noelle, lost in the trance of the Thorn Ring, before she freezes her to death! And who knows, maybe the situation can get even worse than that?

Game.name: Delta Force: Angel Falls
Game.description_short:
This game title was cancelled.

In the near future, set in the north-west region of Central America and spanning both Colombia and Venezuela, “Delta Force: Angel Falls” presents the rural, sparsely populated areas of this exotic locale.  The South American environment provides a premise which is naturally beautiful and full of new millennium conflicts.

Marginal governments, involved in local expansionism, continually scuffle with one another and with major global powers. Complicating matters, drug cartels have evolved beyond money to political forces rivaling established governments. Influenced by current events, the game is both topical and novel.

The sometimes local philosophy of “your enemy is my friend and your friend is my enemy” gives rise to a multitude of ever-changing alliances and conflicts which drive the game’s rapid action. The culmination of the conflict takes place in the Angel Falls area of Venezuela providing both a spectacular setting and a surprise ending.

Game.name: Deltatraveler: Section 1
Game.description_short: In Ruins (or, alternatively, Section 1) is the first section of Deltatraveler, taking place in Undertale's Ruins.

Game.name: Deltatraveler: Section 2
Game.description_short: Oh, Mother (or, alternatively, Section 2) is the second Section of Deltatraveler, taking place in Earthbound's world.

Game.name: Deltatraveler: Section 3
Game.description_short: Hell's Forest (or, alternatively, Section 3) is the third Section of Deltatraveler, taking place in the world of GG!Underfell.

Game.name: Delta Force: Land Warrior
Game.description_short:
Engage the enemy across vast outdoor environments and expansive indoor environments as you take control of the US Army's elite anti-terrorist unit. Delta Force Land Warrior introduces new weapons and characters for both single player and intense online multiplayer via NovaWorld.
Select from a team of diverse characters, each with their own special abilities. (Sniper, Demolitions, Close Quarters Battle, Aquatics and Heavey Gunner)
Advanced new rifles, systems, machine guns and grenade launcher
Developed from the same engine used to train the US ARMY elite Land Warrior Soldiers
Wage war on the massive battlefields of NovaWorld with up to 50 players simultaneously
Rank Yourself against your enemies and allies on NovaWorld

Game.name: DeltaBlade 2700 Re:Create
Game.description_short: Fight your friends as a cyberpunk robot ninja mercenary in DeltaBlade 2700 Re:Create, the remake of the original DeltaBlade 2700. It’s the same high energy, competitive local multiplayer brawler with fast paced sword combat and jetpacks you love, but with tons more features!

Game.name: Deltarune: Broken Destiny
Game.description_short:
Deltarune: Broken Destiny is a tale set in the original Deltarune universe.
We see a new part of Deltarune's world away from Hometown.

Game.name: Delta Force: Black Hawk Down
Game.description_short: In late 1993, the United States launched dual military operations in Mogadishu Somalia. Delta Force Operatives and Army Rangers were sent in to capture Somali warlords and restore order. Experience the intense combat of Operation Restore Hope in this ground breaking first person shooter. As a Delta Force operative participate in a number of daring and intense raids against the oppressive Somali warlords in and around Mogadishu.

Game.name: Delta Ops: Army Special Forces
Game.description_short: Delta Ops ASP is a shooter developed by Activision Value. You are part of a counter-terrorist squad in a mission to kill the infidels.

Game.name: Deltarune - Spamton Restitched
Game.description_short: a fan-made sequel to the Spamton Neo fight.

Game.name: Delta Force: Black Hawk Down - Team Sabre
Game.description_short:
Delta Force: Black Hawk Down - Team Sabre is the official expansion pack.
The game is a military-based shooter but the missions are fictitious and not based on any actual real events. The expansion follows the Team Sabre Squadron as they are deployed to take out targets and carry out mission objectives in two separate single player campaigns (*approximately 5 missions each) that take place in Columbia and Iran. The multiplayer feature boasts 30 new maps and an enhanced level of mod support for players to build their own unique maps.

Game.name: Delta Force: Black Hawk Down Platinum Pack
Delta Force: The Awakening - Task Force Dagger
Game.description_short:
As the US army's elite special operations soldiers you are the most potent 'smart weapon' known to man. You are the 'tip of the spear' for covert operations around the world — you are the first line of attack. Nothing stands in your way. From the war torn streets of Somalia you have been re-deployed to take out targets in Colombia and Iran. As the US military's preemptive strike force you must work with your team to get the job done.
Features
BECOME THE BEST — Play as any one of these Special Forces units: SFOD-Delta, 2/75th RANGER, SEAL Team 6, SFOD-SF Viper Team (Green Berets), CIA Special Operations, UK SAS 22 Regiment, Australian SASR, Canadian JTF-2, Marines Force Recon, and USAF CSAR (Air Force Pararescue) — all the actual Special Forces units deployed in Operation Enduring Freedom.
INFILTRATE ACTUAL LOCATIONS — 25 new Delta Force missions! Take over the Kandahar Airport, raid rebel headquarters in Mazar-e-Sharif, ambush a convoy near the Pakistani border and demolish bunkers in the foothills of Kabul.
OVER 30 WEAPONS TO CHOOSE FROM — Gear up with a huge arsenal of machine guns, assault rifles, sniper rifles, pistols and rocket launchers new to the Delta Force series.
SPY ON THE ENEMY — Plan your attack with the element of surprise using visual intelligence gathered from Unmanned Aerial Vehicles.
RAIN DESTRUCTION FROM THE SKIES — Call in devastating air strikes to take out key SAM and SCUD missile sites.
LARGE-SCALE MULTIPLAYER — Create your own multiplayer games and maps with the mission editor. 10 new multiplayer maps included! *Battle online via NovaWorld.

Game.name: Deltarune: Chapter Rewritten - Scampton The Great
Game.description_short: Deltarune: Chapter Rewritten created by The Winterer is a roleswap AU with the spirit of a kid's cartoon, follow Asriel, Noelle and Charkis down the dreaded abyss of Kueen's dungeon and free this sad, strange little man.

Game.name: Deltarune Wandering Makers: Pantheon of the Discarded
Game.description_short: Taking off from the original storyline, you explore a strange new "darker-than-dark" world, looking for "shadow bosses" to battle for their "Shadow Crystals"

Game.name: Delta 78
Game.description_short: A crew member wakes up alone on a silent ship. Something is wrong. Something is watching. Delta 78: The Passenger is a dark sci-fi experience with interactive storytelling and stealth gameplay.

Game.name: Deltagun
Game.description_short:
You have a gun.
Shoot enemies.
They run away from you.

Game.name: Delta Park
Game.description_short: Delta Park is a horror and exploration title with a retro style. After being attacked by a strange being and our pet “Pepa” disappears without a trace, the search will lead us to discover the twisted origin of the creature and its creator. We must find Pepa, and return home safe and sound.

Game.name: Deltarules
Game.description_short: Deltarules is a Deltarune Hard mode with internet humor, new bosses and new bullet patterns

Game.name: Delta MMORPG
Game.description_short: Online MMO RPG filled with adventure & action. Slash enemies or use magic to conquer. Embark on quests, delve into stories, encounter dragons, orcs, elves & more. Choose your class: Warrior (Guardian/Knight), Archer (Hunter/Ranger), Mage (Wizard/Archmage), or Priest (Druid/Cleric).

Game.name: Delta Vector
Game.description_short: Delta Vector is a unique turn-based racing indie game that combines tactical decision-making with vector-based physics. Master the art of precision racing as you calculate your every move across challenging tracks!

Game.name: Delta Z. INC
Game.description_short: Delta Z Inc. is a horror sci-fi puzzle game where you work as a repurposing technician, responsible for modifying reanimated bodies to suit the needs of your clients while keeping within the company's budget.

Game.name: Delta Squared
Game.description: Delta Squared is an abstract Shoot'em up game made in retro 8-bit style in modern times. Has 4 stages, 2 game campaign modes and a local coop mode. Also has unlockable color palettes.
Game.description_short:
Change the destiny of Delta Town!

Square Queen Shiberia has invaded the city with the Square army! They want to transform all citizens into squares, and only you can save them!

Game.name: Deltascention
Game.description_short: Deltascention is a fast-paced action roguelike with a ton of upgrades and a whole collection of editable arena's, and not to mention the weapons! Fight your way through all 50 waves to take out the final boss and save the world outside!

Game.name: Deltagun Deluxe
Game.description_short: DELTARUNE but you have a gun and it's not just a simple gun... IT'S THE STRONGEST WEAPON IN THE UNIVERSE, that have 2 gimmicks.

Game.name: Deltarune: Chapter 3
Game.description_short: A chapter for Deltarune. It released alongside chapter 4.

Game.name: Deltarune: Chapter 4
Game.description_short: A chapter for Deltarune. It released alongside chapter 3.

Game.name: Deltarune: Chapter 5
Game.description_short: An upcoming chapter for Deltarune.

Game.name: Deltarune: Master Mode
Game.description_short: Deltarune: Master Mode is a fan-made "hard mode" mod that re-imagines the game with increased difficulty. It features stronger enemies and a more challenging experience, where only the most skilled players will be able to survive.

Game.name: Deltarune Sakuya Battle
Game.description_short: This is a demo of the a Deltarune and Touhou fan game. Kris finds himself a new enemy that can control time! The Scarlet Devil Mansion chief maid Sakuya Izayoi.

Game.name: Deltarune: Rouxls Kaard
Game.description_short: Witness the Duke of Puzzles, the Crafty Box-Maker, the... Lesser Dad? Fight in a battle of wit and unfair advantages readily given to your opponent, thee Rouxls Kaard. Puzzling jukes, jabs, and jars are sure to trip you up so keep your head (and your HP) high whilst combat commenceth.

Game.name: Deltarune: Plugged Dream
Game.description_short:
After completing the Mantle minigames in the S-Rank room, Susie shows up and pulls you out of them, leaving you with... A LOT of questions.
But… what if things didn’t go quite the same?

What if something was... weirder?

That's where the idea is coming from:

Now, after completing these minigames, Ramb comes in to ask you some questions of games and how fun they were. But after that, he tells that there are lots, lots of unfinished Mantle prototypes exist on discarded cartridges, but, as Ramb knows, none will boot on the console. With jealousy that Kris won't be able play the games, Ramb decides to tell a backup plan, and...

Well, something surely happens!

Game.name: Deltarune: Wilter's Wonderland
Game.description_short:
This is a Deltarune fangame about the character, Wilter

A secret boss interpretation for Deltarune Chapter 3, based off of the flowers in Toriel's trashcan.

Wilter is a funny little flower clown, who loves to play games with his best friend, you!

Doesn’t that sound Wonderfull?

This fangame contains both the battle and Wilter’s sidequest!

Game.name: Delta Force: Season 1 - Genesis
Game.description_short:
Delta Force: Season 1 – Genesis is the thrilling first chapter in the revival of the legendary tactical shooter series. Released in December 2024, this season sets the tone for a gripping episodic experience that combines cutting-edge technology with the strategic gameplay that made the franchise iconic.

In Season 1: Genesis, players step into the boots of an elite Delta Force operator tasked with counter-terrorism and high-stakes covert operations across the globe. From desert encampments to urban strongholds and icy tundras, every mission presents unique challenges that test your tactical prowess, decision-making, and combat skills.

Game.name: Deltarune: A Different Snowgrave
Game.description_short: A Deltarune Fan-Game containing creative, difficult battle based on the "Snowgrave" route from Deltarune Chapter 2, as well as several unlockable achievements!

Game.name: Deltarune: Reimagined - Angelic Altercation
Game.description_short:
Deltarune:Reimagined - ANGELIC ALTERCATION is the first small fangame of Deltarune:Reimagined created by ZET, an Alternate Universe of Toby Fox's Deltarune— showing the first battle you have with Chapter 4's Secret Boss.

In it, you play as Kris, who, after falling from a very high place while trying to escape from the Faith Enforcer, has lost their friends and must traverse a Crystalline Forest, when all of the sudden, they find a strange path...

Game.name: Vision Crew's Deltarune: Alternate Chapters
Game.description_short:
Vision Crew's Deltarune: Alternate Chapters is a fangame project aiming to interpret Toby Fox's earlier concepts and Chapters, it's entirely speculative and plans to be worked on even once his own content is out!

It includes familiar characters, even ones Toby has namedropped without a design... or vice versa! But you'll also meet a ton of brand new characters!

Game.name: R-Type Delta: HD Boosted
Game.description_short: Your nightmares, now in High Definition! R-Type Delta HD Boosted brings back the dark, iconic shooter with modern enhancements, new music, razor-sharp graphics, and all the intensity you remember.

Game.name: Fishing Planet: Dnipro Delta Pack
Game.description_short: Gear up for a 30-day adventure on the legendary Dnipro River with the Dnipro Delta Pack! This mighty river flows through the heart of Ukraine, home to Fishing Planet's developers.

Game.name: Blue Delta
Game.description_short: Blue Delta is a visual novel about adventures in a strange world.

Game.name: Rugby Tycoon Rugby Rovigo Delta
Game.description_short: An immersive and strategic game experience focused on the management of a rugby club.The game combines tactical decisions with the management of the team, financial planning and competition in a world of rugby.

Game.name: Missile Command: Delta
Game.description_short: Missiles are incoming. The stakes are high. Only you can stop the destruction. Manage your pool of defenses strategically to survive rounds of incoming missiles in this high-pressure, tactical turn-based game. Will you be able to unravel the mystery in time?

Game.name: Strike Team Delta
Game.description_short: Strike Team Delta is a gripping first-person shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world. Battle hordes of undead, team up with friends, and reclaim our world. Survival is in your hands.

Game.name: RoboGal: Gaga Delta Lady
Game.description_short: Rei-Bo was living peacefully on the island of Plutobell, until a giant spaceship crashed into the place! This is a fun and humorous saga to solve this incident full of obstacles and traps! Choose the levels in the order you want, defeat the ship's members and get their weapons in RoboGal!

Game.name: Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater
Game.description: The same gripping story and engrossing world, but now with cutting-edge graphics and 3D audio, which bring the jungle to life. Get ready for the ultimate survival, stealth and action experience.
Game.description_short: Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater is a remake of the 2004 game, Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater, and it follows the story of Naked Snake, a FOX operative, in 1964 during the Cold War. His mission is to rescue a Russian scientist, sabotage a superweapon called Shagohod, and confront his former mentor, The Boss, who has defected. The game explores themes of loyalty, betrayal, and ideological conflict against the backdrop of a jungle setting.

Game.name: Doom Delta
Game.description_short: Doom Delta is a GZDoom mod that aims to bring many elements from the pre-release iterations of Doom, from the press release beta to the original design document by Tom Hall.

Game.name: Doom II: Deltarune Companions - Susie and Ralsei
Game.description_short:
These companion characters come from Deltaruneland and they're
here to aid you in slaying demons or just to accompany you along
in whatever journey you might take!

Game.name: Qualia/Delta
Game.description: A in-development PC otome game.
Game.description_short:
A triangular relationship, samsara, and gods...

Since the dawn of humanity on Earth, countless cultures have risen in different places, prospered, and fallen, over and over again. Ultimately, after satisfying both material and psychological needs in abundance, people have turned to pursuing major social change.

This story takes place in a small country in the northern region. Throughout the year, the temperature is cold, the weather is clear, and at night, the entire sky is filled with stars -- thus, the land is known as "Seijou", the castle of stars.

A religion known as Asterism is established in Seijou. Its chief doctrine is the circle of transmigration: that people still bear the sin of disobeying the gods in the distant past, and are destined to commit the same mistakes anew in their current lives.

Sumire and Shion were homeless children, living on the streets after escaping from kidnappers. By chance, they encountered a boy named Subaru. He was the leader of Asterism, revered by its followers as a god.

Subaru extended his hands to the two of them. "It was fate that we met here. Will you come with me?"

Game.name: Yohane the Parhelion: Costume "Delta Replica"
Game.description_short: Cool Scarlet Delta costumes are newly available for Yohane!

Game.name: The American Delta Vengeance Action Blood Force Kill Commando
Game.description_short: Join and play this C64-funsplatter-pixel-massacre! Made for the fans of Wolfenstein, Doom, Duke Nukem, Shadow Warrior and Redneck Rampage!

Game.name: Protocol Delta
Game.description_short: Protocol Delta is a fast-paced twin-stick arcade game with minimal aesthetics. Test your reflexes as you try to survive relentless waves of geometric enemies.

Game.name: Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater - Sneaking DLC Pack
Game.description_short:
Equip yourself with this DLC pack containing a special set of stealth gear for Snake, including new uniforms, faces, and equipment, available in-game in METAL GEAR SOLID Δ: SNAKE EATER.
Pack Includes:
Uniform: Battle Dress (PW ver.)​
Uniform: Sneaking Suit (PW ver.)​
Uniform: Crocodile Suit​
Uniform: Naked (Woodland)
Uniform: Naked (Ammunition Belt)
Uniform: Gold
Face: Glasses
Face: Sunglasses
Equipment: Kerotan Mask
Equipment: GA-KO Mask

Game.name: Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater - Digital Deluxe Edition
Game.description_short:
The Digital Deluxe Edition includes both the game and the Sneaking DLC Pack at a reduced price.
Includes:
・METAL GEAR SOLID Δ: SNAKE EATER
・Sneaking DLC Pack
Uniform: Battle Dress (PW ver.)​
Uniform: Sneaking Suit (PW ver.)​
Uniform: Crocodile Suit​
Uniform: Naked (Woodland)​
Uniform: Naked (Ammunition Belt)
Uniform: Gold
Face: Glasses
Face: Sunglasses
Equipment: Kerotan Mask
Equipment: GA-KO Mask

Game.name: Mission Delta
Game.description_short: Challenge the tower solo or co-op in this high-octane sky crawler action rogue-lite. Stack power ups and steal destructive weapons as you dodge, dash and mutilate your way to the top. Your retribution awaits.

Game.name: Starport Delta
Game.description_short: Starport Delta is a space station builder where players must balance resources, station maintenance and resident requirements. Juggle the needs of your population against expanding and dealing with whatever space throws your way...

Game.name: Psyvariar Delta
Game.description_short: Psyvariar Delta is a classic shooter known for the Buzz System, where players level up by grazing enemy fire and chaining Buzz. Also included in this version are 2 HD remakes of the arcade classic Psyvariar Medium Unit and Psyvariar Revision with new additional features.

Game.name: Ruzh Delta Z
Game.description_short: Ruzh Delta Z is a frenzied shoot-em-up which draws inspiration from classics such as Gradius, DoDonPachi, and R-Type. Shoot your way through perilous stages and wreck thousands of rogue vessels in your quest to become the ultimate pilot.

Game.name: Far Cry: Delta Sector
Game.description_short: The Delta Sector is a modification for FarCry which will meet the highest quality expectations and will use the full capacity of the Cryengine 1. There will be new weapons, new vehicles and new enemies in this mod. You are a member of a special forces team. It's your job to check what's happening in eastern Europe, because many military forces accumulate in one area.

Game.name: Space Pilgrim Episode III: Delta Pavonis
Game.description_short:
Still reeling from the life-changing events of the previous episode, Gail seeks out a safe haven with her father in the Delta Pavonis system. 
However, she soon learns that the politics of Planet Leto can be as treacherous and unpredictable as the local weather. What's more, her father seems to have disappeared under suspicious circumstances ... can she find him before her enemies catch up with her?

Game.name: Star Chronicles: Delta Quadrant
Game.description_short: Delta Quadrant is a sci-fi turn-based strategy game with lite rogue-like elements. Destroy enemies to collect loot, gain experience to level up and use skill points to become stronger. Intended as a fun little sci-fi title, not too hardcore or difficult.

Game.name: Star Trek Online: Delta Rising
Game.description_short: Delta Rising is Star Trek Online's second expansion, announced at the Official Star Trek Convention in Las Vegas on August 2, 2014. Cryptic had hinted of a new expansion in December 2013, with a release "late in 2014". The expansion is set in the Delta Quadrant, the main setting of Star Trek: Voyager. Tim Russ reprised his role as Admiral Tuvok (who appeared in two feature episodes in Season 9), and he was joined by Garrett Wang as Captain Harry Kim of the USS Rhode Island (established in the Voyager series finale "Endgame"), Jeri Ryan as Seven of Nine, Robert Picardo as the Doctor, and Ethan Phillips as Neelix. Lead Designer Al Rivera said that "several" Voyager cast members would appear in Delta Rising. The level cap was raised from 50 to 60, adding two new ranks for each faction: Admiral and Fleet Admiral for the Federation and the Romulan Republic, and General and Dahar Master for the Klingons. Several Delta Quadrant races that appeared in Voyager will also were included in the new content, as well as a new tier of ships for the higher levels, and a Delta Reputation tree for players to progress through

Game.name: 1942 Delta
Game.description_short: Are you a fan of vertical scrolling shooters? Then you will definitely love 1942. The game will keep you busy and entertained for hours. The year 1942 is widely adopted in video games, considering that it is the middle year of the World War II timeline.

Game.name: Project Delta
Game.description_short: Explore all possible realities as you try and save the multiverse from the Darkness in this unique Procedural Meta-Metroidlike Adventure.

Game.name: Weakpoint Delta
Game.description_short: Asteroids go boom. Zoom around in your lil' ship and learn how to accurately hit weakpoints on asteroids to extract the precious crystals within allowing you to purchase upgrades.

Game.name: Outpost Delta
Game.description_short: Outpost Delta is a single player, 2-D side-scrolling sci-fi shooter for PC. Take on the role of Delta, the outpost’s emergency defense, who along with her AI companion must defend the space station against alien intruders.

Game.name: Protodroid Delta
Game.description: Reach your potential in a fast and fluid 3D action-platformer set in a beautiful and hopeful Solarpunk world. Take on challenging bosses, upgrade your systems, and show humanity the promise of AI.
Game.description_short:
Dr. Shelton has finally created one of the first Protodroids - a droid with near-human levels of intelligence. DeLTA was made to "be the change," as her name suggests, that shows the world the promise of what AI can become. So Delta sets out to show the world that's she's more than 'just a robot' "
However, an attack on Dr. Shelton's lab by a Drone-Gang Dr. Shelton forces her to enable DeLTAs combat subroutines and hurriedly retrofit her with weapons systems in self-defense. After DeLTA successful fends off the attackers, Dr. Shelton realizes that just as DeLTA saved her and the lab she could defend the entire region again'st the rising Drone-Gang threat that is claiming so many civilian lives. And by doing this she will and earn the city’s belief and affection. And that this may be the be the best way to convince the world that she's "more than just a robot" and come to embrace the promise of what AI can become.

Game.name: Life of Delta
Game.description: Embark on a journey through a vast post-apocalyptic environment, full of interesting characters and engaging puzzle games in this sci-fi point-and-click adventure game.
Game.description_short: Our story follows Delta, who is a small service robot and like any other robot, he is just trying to survive in this harsh environment. One day he is forced to embark on a journey through a vast post-apocalyptic world in order to find his lost friend. Because of his small size, he needs to use all of his wits to overcome all dangerous scenarios and challenges.

Game.name: The Tower of TigerQiuQiu: Ninja Delta
Game.description_short: AboutYou finally find the treasure chest at the top of the mountain, so you begin to search all the mountains; Defeat the ninjas who track you and get the chest.FeatureThe DLC include full 10 missions

Game.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition - Convair F-106 Delta Dart
Game.description_short: Convair's superb F-106 Delta Dart is regarded by those close to it as the best all-weather interceptor ever designed. It was created as an outgrowth of the USAF's interceptor program in 1954. The aircraft used a delta wing design, common at the time because of its immunity to many of the problems experienced by conventional wings at...

Game.name: Battle
Game.description_short: "B.A.T.T.L.E. is a high-action single-player FPS with realistic gunplay, intense combat, and stunning graphics. Master 64 unique weapons, customize them with 240 skins, and fight against enemies in immersive war zones."

Game.name: Battlemon
Game.description_short: Battlemon is an action-fighting game where you take control of small, cute character and battle in various different arenas. There are many vibrant and powerful different characters to choose from, with even more being gradually added through updates!

Game.name: Battle Bits
Game.description_short: Defend the system in Battle Bits! In this 2D game, you are a brave Arroba (@) fighting a computer virus. Face enemies from A to Z and bosses from 0 to 9 using signs as weapons. Use Bits to upgrade and defeat the final boss, 9, in this exciting retro adventure!

Game.name: Battle Drive
Game.description_short: Survive on a dying world by taking on the most dangerous missions that no one else can handle; overcoming natural disasters, nefarious opportunists & PVE challenges, while using your skills, strategies & reflexes to save money towards customizing the vehicle that will see you through the apocalypse!

Game.name: Battle Waves
Game.description_short: A fast-paced Card Battler with Tower Defense action! Claim victory in the Roguelite Deckbuilder campaign and Online Multiplayer. Collect all the factions to explore thousands of strategic combinations.

Game.name: Battle Mayhem
Game.description_short: Dive into the action-packed world of Battle Mayhem, a fast-paced multiplayer showdown where strategy, skill, and creativity are your ultimate weapons! Designed for endless fun and fierce competition, Battle Mayhem pits two players against each other in a thrilling fight to be the last one standing.

Game.name: Battle Shapes
Game.description_short: Battle Shapes

Game.name: Battle Squares
Game.description_short: Battle Squares is an online, eight-directional 2D shooter where players control customizable square characters and fight in multiplayer matches using a mix of two class types.

Game.name: Battle AirForce
Game.description_short: Three years after Battle Marine a new battle is about to begin! Battle AirForce is the first orthodox style vertical scrolling bullet hell STG since NOKOGI Rider by SUZUKI PLAN. It was created in Z80 full assembly language, aiming at a level close to the limit of VGS-Zero.

Game.name: Battle of Emperor Tian
Game.description_short: "Battle of Emperor Tian" is a casual tower defense game. In the game, players can skillfully place these turrets. According to the characteristics and attack rhythms of different monsters, they can reasonably match the lineup to ensure the stability of the defensive line.

Game.name: Battle Tanks: World War II
Game.description_short: Meet the legendary tank shooter. Fight in team battles alone or with friends, research and upgrade armored vehicles, try different tactics and win. Choose a tank and join the battle!

Game.name: Battle Ground Battle Royale
Game.description_short: FPS/TPS Multiplayer, battle royale - Alpha version

Game.name: Battle Line the Rise of War
Game.description_short: Dive into Battle Line: The Rise of War, an exhilarating third-person shooter (TPS) that throws you into the heart of fast-paced, action

Game.name: Battle Mythic Maidens Arena
Game.description_short: Engage in card-based combat against alluring opponents in a fantasy world! Face beautiful but dangerous combatants, all with unique stats, strengths and weaknesses. In each turn, you are randomly dealt cards of four action types.

Game.name: Battleships Combat: Evolved
Game.description_short: A classical game, but with a twist! 20 different ships, each with an interesting damage pattern, fight on a battlefield with customizable size and possibly also islands. Against AI or other players on local network.

Game.name: Battle Live! School of idols
Game.description_short:
You play as Ayane/Akiomi, as you through the idol school of Pride Park Secondary. There are two main routes to the game for each wing of the school showing everything it has to offer, as well as a bonus epilogue for seeing both routes.

The game is very linear and should take about an hour to see it to completion.

Game.name: Battlefield 6
Game.description: The ultimate all-out warfare experience. In a war of tanks, fighter jets, and massive combat arsenals, your squad is the deadliest weapon.
Game.description_short:
La experiencia bélica definitiva. Lucha en intensos combates de infantería, atraviesa los cielos en combate aéreo, destruye tu entorno y consigue una ventaja estratégica, y toma el control de todas tus decisiones y movimientos con el sistema de combate cinestésico. 

En una guerra de tanques, cazas y gigantescos arsenales de combate, el arma más mortífera es tu patrulla. Esto es Battlefield 6.
